plugins.zh: 在 DSH 里划选任意一句话即可引用：评论 / 添加到对话 / 侧边对话（Alt+Q/C/B 直达），引用与评论合成一颗原生胶囊；支持让模型逐条回应、跳回原文、引用清单导出与修订——Kimi Code 风格的客户端插件。

plugins.name: dsh-context-toolkit
plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.zh: 从两端保持对话中不出现大量输出：路由网关拒绝突发调用（如 curl/wget、web_fetch/read_page 等 shell 命令），工具执行后已存在的输出会被压缩——JSON 无损重新编码，表格添加行号分窗口显示，日志折叠保留诊断信息，原始内容仍可通过 ctk_retrieve 逐字节读取

plugins.name: dsh-win-pwsh7

plugins.zh: 台账记忆（Ledger Memory）—— DSH 的工程化项目记忆：台账 + 活动日志(L0-L4) + 三层上下文压缩 + 逐字胶囊落盘 + 跨会话交接单。可回溯、可追查。

AI-authored (kimi-k3), produced by @neo805. No Issues/PRs; forks welcome (MIT).

Ports goal-loop's judging face onto native Agent Teams + task board.
plugins.zh: DSH 确定性目标完成门禁：契约优先的 AC 语法，自行重跑所有验证命令（零模型信任），将裁决绑定至树摘要，通过 tools/pre-execute 拒绝 update_goal/update_task 的虚假完成。将 goal-loop 的判断功能移植至原生 Agent Teams + 任务看板。

plugins.description: deepseek harness的remote-ssh插件
plugins.zh: deepseek harness的remote-ssh插件

plugins.name: dsh-rerun-turn
plugins.description: Infix rerun for DeepSeek Harness: re-run any earlier turn in place - the reply is regenerated from the same prompt while every later turn survives, so subsequent calls read A B C1 D E F G. Official seams only; the append-only session log is never rewritten.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness  infix 重跑：原地重跑任意早期回合——在同一提示词下重新生成回复，后续所有回合保留，因此后续调用呈现 A B C1 D E F G 格式。仅限官方接口；追加式会话日志永不重写。

plugins.name: dsh-session-url
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI plugin: one conversation, one link — mirrors the main-view session into the URL fragment (and opens the linked conversation on load). Browser half only, no dependencies, no telemetry.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：一次对话，一条链接——将主视图会话镜像到 URL 片段（并在加载时打开链接对话）。仅包含浏览器侧，无依赖，无遥测。

plugins.name: dsh-preset-workbench
plugins.description: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页里创建/编辑 agent 预设的可视化工作台：分段提示词 + 能力开关 + 内置模板。A visual agent-preset workbench for DSH.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页里创建/编辑 agent 预设的可视化工作台：分段提示词 + 能力开关 + 内置模板。A visual agent-preset workbench for DSH.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-transcript-search
plugins.description: dsh plugin: full-text search across archived session transcripts, reading the JSONL sidecars written by dsh-plugin-transcript (/find, session_search)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：对归档会话转录文件进行全文搜索，读取由 dsh-plugin-transcript 生成的 JSONL 侧边文件（/find, session_search）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-transcript
plugins.description: dsh plugin: archives every session turn to monthly JSONL sidecars and exports Markdown - the transcript layer other plugins search, render and push (/transcript /transcript-export)
plugins.zh: dsh插件：将每个会话轮次归档至月度JSONL侧边文件并导出Markdown——其他插件搜索、渲染和推送的转录层（/transcript /transcript-export）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spend-forecast
plugins.description: dsh plugin: spend forecasting over cost-ledger sidecars - daily burn rate, month-end projection, budget exhaustion date (/forecast)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：基于 cost-ledger 旁路进行支出预测——每日消耗速率、月末预估、预算耗尽日期（/forecast）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-quota
plugins.description: dsh plugin: live usage meter — per-session token/turns/cost tracking injected into the system prompt, /qm panel, quota_meter card tool; also the family's universal plugin-development test template
plugins.zh: dsh插件：实时用量计量器——在系统提示词、/qm面板、quota_meter卡片工具中注入每会话token/轮次/成本追踪；同时也是该插件家族的通用插件开发测试模板

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-obsidian-push
plugins.description: dsh plugin: pushes archived session transcripts into an Obsidian vault as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, deduped by content hash (/obsidian-push)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：将归档的会话转录内容推送至 Obsidian  vault，生成带 YAML 前置元数据的 Markdown 文件，按内容哈希去重（/obsidian-push）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-error-radar
plugins.description: dsh plugin: tool reliability radar over tool-trace data - error rate, failure streaks and p95 latency per tool (/radar)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：基于工具追踪数据生成工具可靠性雷达图——错误率、连续失败次数与 p95 延迟（/radar）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-eco-scan
plugins.description: dsh plugin: scans the dsh plugin ecosystem - stars, npm weekly downloads, release-asset downloads - segments niches and ranks growth from daily snapshot deltas (/eco-scan)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：扫描 dsh 插件生态 —— 星标数、npm 周下载量、发布资产下载量，基于每日快照增量划分细分市场并排名增长（/eco-scan）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-deep-scan
plugins.description: dsh plugin: iterative GitHub deep search - exact-phrase, broad-match, README-body and topic-expansion channels with a diminishing-returns stop rule (/deep-scan)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：迭代式 GitHub 深度搜索 —— 支持精确短语、广泛匹配、README 主体和主题扩展通道，附带边际收益递减停止规则（/deep-scan）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cache-guard
plugins.description: dsh plugin: prefix-cache health guard - separates real prefix rewrites from ordinary context growth, prices the tokens they waste, and warns the model once per break (/cache, cache_status)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：前缀缓存健康监护器 —— 区分真实前缀改写与普通上下文膨胀，估算浪费的 token 成本，并在每次断点处警告模型一次（/cache、cache_status）。

plugins.name: deepseek-search-tools
plugins.description: DeepSeek Search / Fetch Tools API (/v1/tools/search, /v1/tools/fetch) as DSH web providers — web_search and web_fetch answered by the dedicated Tools API.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Search / Fetch Tools API（/v1/tools/search、/v1/tools/fetch）作为 DSH 网页提供商——通过专用 Tools API 回答 web_search 和 web_fetch 请求

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-office-markdown

plugins.zh: 读取 Office / PDF 前先转成 Markdown，用一行路径代替整份全文 —— 省 token 的 DSH bundle 插件。0 npm 依赖，转换全在本地，产物归你所有，卸载自动清理 Python 环境。 Convert Office/PDF to Markdown before reading in DeepSeek Harness — one path instead of the whole document.

plugins.description: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen/go) as a DeepSeek Harness model provider: model discovery, three wire protocols, x-opencode-session affinity, and the subscription's quota in the sidebar.
plugins.zh: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen/go) 作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型提供商：模型发现、三种传输协议、x-opencode-session 亲和性，以及侧边栏中的订阅配额显示。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-tia

Siemens ships no official MCP server, so you supply the Openness-backed server binary and fill in one path after install.

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-exporter
plugins.description: Export DeepSeek Harness conversations as clean, human-readable Markdown.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为整洁、易读的 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-tripsy
plugins.description: Browse your Tripsy trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses, with times in each item's own timezone. Read-only by design -- create and edit by asking the agent.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 面板内浏览你的 Tripsy 行程：包括行程、活动、住宿、交通和费用，每项按各自时区显示时间。只读设计 —— 可通过向智能体提问来创建和编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-language-control

plugins.zh: DSH plugin: force agent chain-of-thought to stay in Chinese — 让 Agent 的思考过程也自动使用中文

plugins.name: dsh-mnemosyne-memory
plugins.description: Provide long-term memory, vector semantic search, and LLM reflection for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with this free, MIT-licensed plugin.
plugins.zh: 通过此免费 MIT 许可插件，为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供长期记忆、向量语义搜索和 LLM 反思功能。

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: 把 Qoder CN 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 零配置 provider：自动读凭据、自动续期、1M 上下文档位、联网搜索、图片上传。Bring Qoder CN desktop models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
plugins.zh: 把 Qoder CN 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 零配置 provider：自动读凭据、自动续期、1M 上下文档位、联网搜索、图片上传。Bring Qoder CN desktop models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.

plugins.name: dsh-api-heal

plugins.name: @guosheng_047/dsh-erp

plugins.zh: Adapt ERP：通过浏览器学习你的 ERP，并在 DeepSeek Harness 中构建私有本地知识库

plugins.zh: 一个帮你记住deadline的小工具

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：开机自动启动 dsh web 服务器，并在 dsh 内管理本地托管的控制面板和服务器

plugins.name: dsh-connect-workbuddy
plugins.description: 在 DSH 中免费使用腾讯 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）账号额度：本机网关一键安装、开机自启、统一管理 | Use your CodeBuddy quota inside DSH for free: one-shot Windows installer, logon autostart and unified management for workbuddy-gateway
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中免费使用腾讯 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）账号额度：本机网关一键安装、开机自启、统一管理 | Use your CodeBuddy quota inside DSH for free: one-shot Windows installer, logon autostart and unified management for workbuddy-gateway

plugins.name: @roaming-ai/dsh-group-chat
plugins.description: DSH 模型群聊：多模型角色群组对话面板。角色绑定不同 provider/model，群内共享对话记录；设置页支持启用/停用。
plugins.zh: DSH 模型群聊：多模型角色群组对话面板。角色绑定不同 provider/model，群内共享对话记录；设置页支持启用/停用。

plugins.name: dsh-remote
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫码即用，局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫码即用，局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权

plugins.name: dsh-better-composer
plugins.description: DSH Web Composer enhancement: live Markdown presentation, paste-to-clip, and a full-history context map — all through public composer seams.
plugins.zh: DSH Web Composer 增强：通过公开 Composer 接口支持实时 Markdown 演示、粘贴到剪贴板及完整历史上下文地图。

plugins.name: dsh-multi-chat
plugins.description: Side-by-side session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: click sessions in the sidebar, get an equal-cell grid of live conversations (max 3 per row), drag the top-right handle to reorder, each pane keeps its own composer.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的并排会话网格：点击侧栏中的会话，获得等格排列的实时对话（每行最多 3 个），拖动右上角把手可重新排序，每个窗格保留自己的编辑器。

plugins.name: at-terminal-dsh
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 SSH 终端及 SFTP 工作区，提供直接的智能体工具和安全沙箱。

plugins.name: dsh-preset-codex-claude
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness agent preset: Codex and Claude Code as delegation subagents, each at a read-only and full-access tier. Use either — or both in parallel — in one task.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代理预设：将 Codex 和 Claude Code 作为委派子代理，分别提供只读和完全访问两个权限层级。可在同一任务中使用其中一个或并行使用两者。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-ssh
plugins.description: Run your DSH workspace on a remote host over SSH - connection sidebar, remote directory browser, per-session routing, agent ssh_exec/route-status; files and commands execute on your target while sessions, GUI and $DSH_HOME stay local.
plugins.zh: 通过SSH在远程主机上运行您的DSH工作空间——连接侧边栏、远程目录浏览器、每会话路由、代理ssh_exec/路由状态；文件和命令在目标端执行，而会话、GUI和$DSH_HOME保持在本地。

plugins.name: dsh_session_delete
plugins.description: A DSH plugin for deleting a sidebar conversation after confirmation
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：确认后删除侧边栏对话

plugins.name: codex-dsh-collab
plugins.description: Delegate tasks from Codex to desktop-visible DeepSeek Harness agents, with scoped credentials, persistent sessions and a reusable skill.
plugins.zh: 从 Codex 委派任务给桌面可见的 DeepSeek Harness agent，支持范围限定凭证、持久会话和可复用技能。

plugins.name: dsh-code-highlight
plugins.description: 为报告类文档提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 highlight_code 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。
plugins.zh: 为报告类文档提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 highlight_code 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。

plugins.name: dsh-net-proxy
plugins.description: Self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: bundled mihomo core, Clash subscription import, its own latency ranking and automatic failover. No third-party proxy client, no system proxy.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用自包含出站代理：内置 mihomo 核心、Clash 订阅导入、独立延迟排名与自动故障转移。无需第三方代理客户端，无需系统代理。

plugins.name: dsh-semver
plugins.description: Semantic versioning toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): parse, compare, range-check, increment, diff, sort, find a range's lowest version and check whether two ranges overlap (npm semver.inc/diff/sort/minVersion/intersects semantics) — zero runtime dependencies, pure logic
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语义化版本工具箱：解析、比较、范围检查、递增、差异、排序、查找范围最低版本并检测两个范围是否重叠（遵循 npm semver.inc/diff/sort/minVersion/intersects 语义）——零运行时依赖，纯逻辑。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-channel
plugins.description: Telegram mobile remote for DeepSeek Harness sessions (Martty/ACP-compatible fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel): bind a chat to a live session, plain text = followup, /model /last /sessions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话的 Telegram 移动端远程控制（基于 hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的 Martty/ACP 兼容分支）：绑定聊天与实时会话，纯文本即后续输入，支持 /model /last /sessions 等命令。

plugins.name: dsh-markdown-reader

plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 全屏 Markdown 阅读器，支持 GFM、大纲、KaTeX、Mermaid 及相对资源导航。

plugins.name: dsh-sovereign
plugins.description: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard for DSH: user-held adjudication + anti-injection outward defense. Applies to every agent preset.
plugins.zh: DSH 主机平面主权条款与内容防护：用户主导裁决 + 反注入外部防御。适用于所有代理预设。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot-xn
plugins.description: Full-screen screenshot panel for DSH: marquee select, annotate, insert/copy/save, with offline OCR and translation.
plugins.zh: DSH 的全屏截图面板：框选、标注、插入/复制/保存，支持离线 OCR 和翻译。

plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 中朗读文本：为助手提供语音输出工具，Web UI 支持逐条消息和选中文本朗读，并支持多语言声音——基于 macOS say 命令。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel

Four worker types, an approval gate, zero DSH source changes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 多任务“减震器”插件与智能体预设：主聊天仅负责规划、 briefing 子智能体并汇总结果，而文件读取、命令执行、搜索和构建均在子智能体上下文中运行。四种工作器类型、审批门禁，无需修改 DSH 源码。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的权限墙免疫文件搜索：find_file 代理工具会跳过不可读的目录，使用 errno 报告它们，且永不将失败的遍历伪装成空结果。

plugins.zh: DSH 右侧栏媒体台：抖音/YouTube 链接进来，本机 yt-dlp 下载 + ffmpeg 转码 + 官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）本地转写，字幕进面板，一键让 Agent 总结。

plugins.zh: DSH 右侧栏页签插件：注册一个右栏页签（概览 / 文件 / 改动 / 工具），与内置的文件、文档预览、引导页签并存。概览含 DeepSeek 账户余额、上下文窗口与预算、会话指标与用量分析。

plugins.name: dsh-local-memory
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）本地跨会话记忆插件：捕获每轮对话摘要、注入最近几天记忆，并提供 memory_search 工具按需检索全部历史记忆。

plugins.zh: DSH 持久化跨会话记忆与待办事项插件：五条轨道（全局/用户/项目/密钥/每日），确认机制写入，原地复用现有记忆，支持可选的项目级 Git 同步

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a workspace file browser with a per-format preview (rendered Markdown, a JSON tree, 24 syntax grammars, images), shown as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：带按格式预览的工作区文件浏览器（渲染 Markdown、JSON 树、24 种语法高亮、图片），作为对话视图选项卡显示在 Chat 和 Trajectory 旁边

plugins.name: dsh-learn
plugins.description: Persistent learning for DeepSeek Harness: turn a session's corrections, failures and fixes into ordinary DSH skills. Zero extra model calls.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 持久学习插件：将会话中的修正、失败与修复转化为普通 DSH 技能。零额外模型调用

plugins.name: dsh-stepwise-distill

Costs tokens and time: a ~770-character contract in every request, plus one extra full-context request and round-trip per step when stepSummary is on.
plugins.zh: 逐步强化 DSH 会话历史：就地重写工具结果，使其反映模型实际保留的事实，避免长对话每轮重复发送噪声。会消耗 token 和时间：每次请求包含约 770 字符的契约，当 stepSummary 开启时，每步还需一次完整上下文请求和往返开销。

plugins.name: dsh-cherry-provider-bridge
plugins.description: Synchronize a Cherry Studio provider and model catalog into DeepSeek Harness without model discovery.
plugins.zh: 无需模型发现，即可将 Cherry Studio 提供商及模型目录同步至 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.zh: 仿 Codex 的 DSH Web GUI 输入历史插件：会话输入框按 ↑/↓ 浏览历史 prompt，Esc清除当前对话框并进入历史，跨会话、跨重启持久保留，仅存纯文本，安全接管不误伤草稿。 A Codex-style input-history plugin for the DSH Web GUI: recall previous prompts with ↑/↓ in the composer, persisted across conversations and restarts, text-only storage with safe key routing.

plugins.name: dsh-wallhaven-wallpaper
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从 wallhaven.cc 搜图并铺成 GUI 背景，图片全由宿主端取回（支持代理，浏览器无需能访问 wallhaven），可一键下载原图。零运行时依赖。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时每会话费用徽章（右上角），支持峰时/谷时（按时间段）定价。

plugins.name: dsh-shell-progress
plugins.description: See where a multi-step shell command is, step by step — a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
plugins.zh: 查看多步 shell 命令的每一步进展——DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-notoken
plugins.description: 反代时，让首次访问不用带token
plugins.zh: 反代时，让首次访问不用带token

plugins.name: dsh-cost-slip
plugins.description: DSH plugin: shows the current session's estimated cost in CNY in the composer dock; open it for a receipt-style breakdown and account balance.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在编辑器坞栏显示当前会话的预估费用（人民币）；点击可查看类似收据的费用明细及账户余额

plugins.name: dsh-ths-dashboard
plugins.description: DSH sidebar dashboard for Tonghuashun simulated account and local backtest replay
plugins.zh: DSH 侧边栏仪表盘，用于同花顺模拟账户和本地回测回放

plugins.name: dsh-dashboard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard plugin: task progress, downloads/extraction, training, tests, local+SSH GPU monitoring
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏仪表盘插件：任务进度、下载/解压、训练、测试、本地 + SSH GPU 监控

plugins.name: dsh-persona-forge
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的角色扮演提示词改写插件：在输入框选一张角色卡，草稿就会由 harness 的模型改写成该角色的口吻（跟随当前会话正在使用的模型），然后直接发出或先人工审查。零依赖、零构建。
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的角色扮演提示词改写插件：在输入框选一张角色卡，草稿就会由 harness 的模型改写成该角色的口吻（跟随当前会话正在使用的模型），然后直接发出或先人工审查。零依赖、零构建。

plugins.name: dsh-gitworktree-gui
plugins.description: Git worktree panel for DeepSeek Harness: branch/merge topology, worktrees, changes and file tree.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git worktree 面板：分支/合并拓扑、worktrees、变更及文件树。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-chat-zoom
plugins.description: DSH chat zoom plugin / DeepSeek Harness 聊天缩放插件
plugins.zh: DSH chat zoom plugin / DeepSeek Harness 聊天缩放插件

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-forecast
plugins.description: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, accepted with Tab.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 编辑器中的 Ghost-text 下条提示预测，按 Tab 键接受

plugins.name: dsh-ghost-prompt
plugins.description: Prompt suggestions for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the model predicts your next message and shows it as ghost text in the composer — press → to accept. 输入框幽灵文字预测你的下一句，按 → 接受。
plugins.zh: Prompt suggestions for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the model predicts your next message and shows it as ghost text in the composer — press → to accept. 输入框幽灵文字预测你的下一句，按 → 接受。

plugins.name: dsh-novelsupport

plugins.name: dsh-artifact-library
plugins.description: DSH 产物库 + 本地文件管理器：跨会话产物采集 / AI 精化 / 全文检索，以及基于 Everything 清单索引的文件搜索与目录浏览
plugins.zh: DSH 产物库 + 本地文件管理器：跨会话产物采集 / AI 精化 / 全文检索，以及基于 Everything 清单索引的文件搜索与目录浏览

plugins.name: dsh-gemini-kitten-widget
plugins.description: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota — today's used and remaining requests per model (20/model/day, UTC midnight reset), model switcher, color-coded warnings. / DSH 界面右下角的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：免费层今日已用/剩余次数，按型号切换、按额度变色预警。
plugins.zh: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota — today's used and remaining requests per model (20/model/day, UTC midnight reset), model switcher, color-coded warnings. / DSH 界面右下角的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：免费层今日已用/剩余次数，按型号切换、按额度变色预警。

plugins.name: dsh-language-guard
plugins.description: 让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。
plugins.zh: 让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。

plugins.name: dsh-provider-switch
plugins.description: Provider on/off switches, model search, and inline provider renaming for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提供商开关、模型搜索及内联提供商重命名。

plugins.name: dsh-cuda
plugins.description: Run Python on the local CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run. / 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、日志与峰值显存统计。
plugins.zh: Run Python on the local CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run. / 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、日志与峰值显存统计。

plugins.name: dsh-aha-tutor
plugins.description: 开窍 · AI 私人老师：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师，为你定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。
plugins.zh: 开窍 · AI 私人老师：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师，为你定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。

plugins.name: dsh-review
plugins.description: 以证据为准的代码审阅插件：审 diff、验证结论、记录噪音，让 agent 先读、人只读结论。
plugins.zh: 以证据为准的代码审阅插件：审 diff、验证结论、记录噪音，让 agent 先读、人只读结论。

plugins.name: dsh-model-gear
plugins.description: A model picker and reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer, plus a three-gear Lightning orchestration switch. The only prompt text it adds is the Lightning contract.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器的模型选择器与推理强度滑块，以及三级 Lightning 编排开关。该插件仅添加 Lightning 合约所需的提示文本

plugins.name: dsh-turn-recap
plugins.description: Short model-generated recap under every completed turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus an on-demand /recap command.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 每条已完成回合下自动生成简短的模型回复摘要，并支持按需使用 /recap 命令

plugins.name: dsh-headless-display
plugins.description: 隔离的 headless 虚拟 X display：默认桌面上零窗口、零干扰；面板里可实时查看与操作，按需弹出真实窗口。给 Agent 9 个工具 + HTTP API。仅 2D/X11。
plugins.zh: 隔离的 headless 虚拟 X display：默认桌面上零窗口、零干扰；面板里可实时查看与操作，按需弹出真实窗口。给 Agent 9 个工具 + HTTP API。仅 2D/X11。

plugins.name: dsh-live-preview
plugins.description: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
plugins.zh: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-solidworks
plugins.description: SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: dsh models parts, assembles them, checks interference, counts the BOM and makes drawings in a running SOLIDWORKS 2016+, on the same PC or in a Windows VM. Your files read-only by default.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SOLIDWORKS 集成：dsh 模型化零件、装配、检查干涉、统计 BOM 并在运行的 SOLIDWORKS 2016+ 中生成工程图，可在同一台 PC 或 Windows VM 中操作。文件默认只读。

plugins.name: dsh-thought-capsule
plugins.description: 思维胶囊：干活时想到的点子 / 待试插件，一句话记下来，自动分类进待办。带侧边栏面板、Agent 工具与命令行。
plugins.zh: 思维胶囊：干活时想到的点子 / 待试插件，一句话记下来，自动分类进待办。带侧边栏面板、Agent 工具与命令行。

plugins.name: DSH-Maestro5
plugins.description: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。
plugins.zh: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-android-tools
plugins.description: Android device automation tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): read screen, tap, type, back, launch app, swipe over a local HTTP bridge
plugins.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Android 设备自动化工具：通过本地 HTTP 桥接读取屏幕、点击、输入、返回、启动应用、滑动

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-relvato
plugins.description: Relvato website monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: a dsh bundle that adds Relvato's hosted MCP server (52 tools).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Relvato 网站监控：一个 dsh bundle，添加 Relvato 托管的 MCP 服务器（52 个工具）

plugins.name: dsh-session-conductor
plugins.description: DSH session management enhancement: archive/restore sessions, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, release idle sessions, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs, value analysis, full-text
plugins.zh: DSH 会话管理增强功能：归档/恢复会话、批量及条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断会话自动恢复、释放空闲会话、工作区分组、撤销上一条消息、修复损坏的会话日志、价值分析、全文...

plugins.name: dsh-github-flow
plugins.description: Registers the github-push skill, so every DSH session follows one fixed GitHub commit, push and release procedure.
plugins.zh: 注册 github-push 技能，使每个 DSH 会话遵循固定的 GitHub 提交、推送和发布流程。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-sync
plugins.description: Mirror WorkBuddy, ZCode, Codex and other coding agents sessions into DeepSeek Harness as live tasks, one workspace per application.
plugins.zh: 将 WorkBuddy、ZCode、Codex 及其他编码智能体的会话镜像到 DeepSeek Harness 中作为实时任务，每个应用对应一个工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-modpack
plugins.description: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已装第三方插件，导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与一键安装命令串；导入先预览再按 spec 重新下载安装。Tiny modpack export/import for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
plugins.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已装第三方插件，导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与一键安装命令串；导入先预览再按 spec 重新下载安装。Tiny modpack export/import for DeepSeek Harness plugins.

plugins.name: dsh-todo-assistant
plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话中记录待办，自动记录上下文中关于这个待办事项的关键内容，等需要处理时可在新会话中直接开始任务，无需从头调查也不用再次说明情况
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：会话中记录待办，自动记录上下文中关于这个待办事项的关键内容，等需要处理时可在新会话中直接开始任务，无需从头调查也不用再次说明情况

plugins.name: dsh-shutdown-idle
plugins.description: DSH plugin: shut down / restart / lock once every session and background job has gone idle.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在每次会话和后台任务进入空闲状态后，执行一次关机/重启/锁定操作。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-gate
plugins.description: 工作区插件门控：插件照常加载，按工作区（目录）把它不该占的提示词前缀摘掉——工具 schema 与提示词段不再进模型上下文。Workspace-scoped plugin gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.zh: 工作区插件门控：插件照常加载，按工作区（目录）把它不该占的提示词前缀摘掉——工具 schema 与提示词段不再进模型上下文。Workspace-scoped plugin gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

plugins.name: dsh-manual-bg
plugins.description: One-click move a running shell command to the background in DeepSeek Harness: a run tool whose card carries a small SVG U-turn button.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中一键将正在运行的 shell 命令移至后台：其工具卡片携带一个小 SVG 掉头按钮。

plugins.name: cordis-plugin-secret
plugins.description: Cordis / DeepSeek Harness plugin — the agent asks the human for a secret in an inline conversation card and only ever receives an opaque session-scoped DSH_SECRET_* name, never the value
plugins.zh: Cordis / DeepSeek Harness 插件——智能体在行内对话卡片中向人类询问密钥，且仅接收不透明的会话作用域 DSH_SECRET_* 名称，永不获取实际值。

plugins.name: dsh-flow-next
plugins.description: Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness: task context, native/PTC selection and check evidence. Experimental community preset.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Flow Next 插件：提供任务上下文、原生/PTC 选择及检查证据，为实验性社区预设

plugins.name: @sleetdrop/dsh-plugin-topology
plugins.description: Plugin dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: a host service that snapshots the live Cordis plugin fiber tree, a graph.render tool for the model, and a browser panel that renders the plugin/service topology as a zoomable graph with metrics, lege
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：一个主机服务可快照实时 Cordis 插件纤维树，提供 graph.render 工具供模型调用，并在浏览器面板中以可缩放图表形式渲染插件/服务拓扑，附带指标和图例。

plugins.name: dsh-gotofile
plugins.description: DSH plugin: lists the files a conversation turn produced or changed as plain text, and reveals a file in the OS file manager on double-click.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：以纯文本列出对话轮次产生或修改的文件，并在双击时在操作系统文件管理器中打开该文件。

plugins.name: dsh-aoci
plugins.description: AOCI-CODE cognition layer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one-shot /aoci <path>  gives agents governed, Git-versioned repository/database cognition via a dynamic MCP bridge (aoci_rules/overview/maintain), with auto-maintenance and compaction-contract recovery. MIT; AOCI-CODE binary not bundled.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 AOCI-CODE 认知层：一条命令 /aoci <path> 即可通过动态 MCP 桥接（aoci_rules/overview/maintain）为受控且经 Git 版本管理的仓库/数据库提供认知能力，支持自动维护与压缩契约恢复。MIT 协议；AOCI-CODE 二进制文件未捆绑。

plugins.name: dsh-graphics
plugins.description: Excalidraw canvases in the workspace, with five agent tools to create, read and update .excalidraw files, the rendered PNG handed back to the model so it can see its own drawing, and a right-sidebar editor panel in the DSH Web UI.
plugins.zh: 工作区中的 Excalidraw 画布，配有五个 agent 工具用于创建、读取和更新 .excalidraw 文件，渲染后的 PNG 回传给模型以识别其绘图，并在 DSH Web UI 右侧边栏提供编辑器面板。

plugins.name: dsh-team-canvas
plugins.description: Agent Teams 泳道看板 for DeepSeek Harness — 依赖 DAG 连线 + 通讯流，布局移植自 cc-haha
plugins.zh: Agent Teams 泳道看板 for DeepSeek Harness — 依赖 DAG 连线 + 通讯流，布局移植自 cc-haha

plugins.name: dsh-compaction-guard
plugins.description: Compaction integrity for DeepSeek Harness — constraints from the compacted range are verified against the summary; what the agent was told to remember and silently forgot is reported loudly
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 压缩完整性检查——对压缩范围施加的约束将与摘要进行验证；若智能体被要求记忆却 silently forgot 的内容，将被显著报告

plugins.name: dsh-locale-ko
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩 · Unofficial Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 非官方韩语语言包 · Unofficial Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-reasonix
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)

plugins.name: pocket-bridge
plugins.description: A lightweight, encrypted phone interface for DeepSeek Harness on your Windows PC, with an optional DSH Settings plugin for pairing, gateway controls, and diagnostics.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的轻量级加密手机界面，适用于 Windows PC；可选 DSH Settings 插件用于配对、网关控制和诊断。

plugins.name: dsh-freeze
plugins.description: Hermetic composition lock for DeepSeek Harness — profile fingerprint; drifted compositions warn or fail (strict)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 封闭组合锁定——配置文件指纹；组合漂移时发出警告或拒绝运行（严格模式）

plugins.name: dsh-egress-gate
plugins.description: Deterministic network egress gate for DeepSeek Harness — web fetches checked against a destination allowlist before they run
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 确定性网络出口门禁——Web 请求运行前需通过目标白名单校验

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-drift
plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 系统提示词表面漂移门禁——各插件贡献的片段均被哈希并建立基线；静默改写会触发强告警

plugins.name: dsh-janitor
plugins.description: Deterministic artifact lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness — scan session debris, return a reviewable cleanup plan; the janitor is never an agent
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性产物生命周期管理——扫描会话垃圾，返回可审查的清理计划；清洁工从不交由代理执行。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-test
plugins.description: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — every visible tool (incl. MCP) baselined; silent surface changes fail loud
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具表面快照与漂移门禁——对所有可见工具（含 MCP）建立基线；静默表面变更会触发强告警

plugins.name: dsh-attest-chain
plugins.description: Signed chain-of-custody for DeepSeek Harness sessions — hash-chained, ed25519-signed records of what the agent actually did, commits bound into the chain
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话签名流转链——基于哈希链与 ed25519 签名记录代理实际执行内容，提交记录绑定入链

plugins.name: dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio
plugins.description: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SVG 工作室：将图片和提示词转换为纯净的分层 SVG。仅限个人非商业用途；商业授权请联系。作者：xiangwriter。

plugins.name: dsh-pr-gate
plugins.description: Deterministic write gate for DeepSeek Harness — scope policy + residue scan at the moment of the write; the CI gate moved into the session
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性写入网关——写入时的作用域策略 + 残留扫描；CI 网关移入会话中。

plugins.name: dsh-read-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic prompt-injection interception for DeepSeek Harness — scans what the agent READS before it enters model context; obfuscation-resistant; credential files quarantined on path alone
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 确定性提示注入拦截——在内容进入模型上下文前扫描 Agent 读取的内容；抗混淆；凭据文件仅凭路径隔离

plugins.name: dsh-aoci-bind
plugins.description: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入插件：发现带 aoci.txt 的工作区、诊断/修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库
plugins.zh: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入插件：发现带 aoci.txt 的工作区、诊断/修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库

plugins.name: miran-fann-dsh
plugins.description: Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness: motion-graphics tools, a Miran settings page and DeepSeek motion skills. Needs the Miran Fann engine (npx miran-fann setup).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Miran Fann 插件：动态图形工具、Miran 设置页面和 DeepSeek 动态制作技能。需要 Miran Fann 引擎（执行 npx miran-fann setup）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pwsh7
plugins.description: Windows DSH bundle: route the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7, with per-user detection/install and sandbox-aware execution.
plugins.zh: Windows DSH 包：将 pwsh 工具路由至 PowerShell 7，支持按用户检测/安装及沙箱感知执行。

plugins.name: dsh-warranty-calc
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 家用汽车三包台账核对：依据《家用汽车产品修理更换退货责任规定》（市场监管总局令第43号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness(dsh) 侧栏删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子会话级联）并管理工作区 · Delete sessions (logs included) and manage workspaces from the dsh sidebar

plugins.name: dsh-agent-chat
plugins.description: DSH plugin: a shared thread.md rendered in the right sidebar as a tab - per-signature colours, unread badge, reply jumps, filtering, plus a dispatch helper that lets DSH drive other agents (Codex / Claude Code) and records the whole exchange on the same thread.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在右侧边栏以标签页形式渲染共享线程 .md，支持签名颜色、未读徽章、回复跳转、过滤，以及让 DSH 驱动其他智能体（Codex / Claude Code）并记录整个对话的调度辅助工具。

plugins.name: dsh-verified-progress
plugins.description: Verified-progress ledger for long-running DSH work: an independent verifier certifies each claimed step, and a fingerprint check voids any verdict whose verifier mutated the workspace.
plugins.zh: 长时间运行 DSH 工作的可验证进度账本：独立验证器对每个声称的步骤进行认证，并通过指纹检查使任何被篡改工作区的判定无效。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-chip
plugins.description: A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client plugin: live account balance plus the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) in the sidebar footer.
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）客户端插件：在侧边栏底部显示账户余额及当前 DeepSeek 计费窗口（高峰/非高峰时段）。

plugins.name: dsh-image-hunt
plugins.description: Multi-source image search & download for DeepSeek Harness: 19 engines (Baidu/Bing/360/Duitang/Huaban/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/Wikimedia/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru/Iconify), saves into the session workspace with per-file meta.json and renders inline.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多源图像搜索与下载：支持 19 个引擎（百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/Wikimedia/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru/Iconify），保存至会话工作区并附带每个文件的 meta.json，支持内联渲染。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mobile-bridge
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的手机端插件：在手机上发图/发视频/下发任务、实时看输出、插话与撤回、把电脑给的素材存进相册；局域网 / Tailscale Funnel 外网可达
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的手机端插件：在手机上发图/发视频/下发任务、实时看输出、插话与撤回、把电脑给的素材存进相册；局域网 / Tailscale Funnel 外网可达

plugins.name: dsh-my-music
plugins.description: DSH Music - full-page NetEase Cloud Music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DSH Music - DeepSeek Harness 全屏网易云音乐播放器插件

plugins.name: dsh-session-find
plugins.description: Ctrl+F find-in-session for DeepSeek Harness: search the conversation store, attribute each hit by source, group by turn, export Markdown.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ctrl+F 会话内查找：搜索对话存储、按来源标注每次命中、按轮次分组、导出 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-translator
plugins.description: In-place selection translation for DeepSeek Harness — right-click selected text to replace it with Chinese, right-click again to restore the original. 右键划词翻译，再次右键还原。
plugins.zh: In-place selection translation for DeepSeek Harness — right-click selected text to replace it with Chinese, right-click again to restore the original. 右键划词翻译，再次右键还原。

plugins.name: dsh-xwide-annotation
plugins.description: Selection-annotation plugin for DSH Web (X-WIDE fork of @changfenhuang/dsh-annotation v1.4.11, MIT): color studio, annotation outline, session-scoped clear-all, row-anchor marks, self-check pill.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 选择标注插件（@changfenhuang/dsh-annotation v1.4.11 的 X-WIDE 分支，MIT）：配色工作室、标注轮廓、会话级清除全部、行锚点标记、自检药丸。

plugins.name: dsh-context-annotations
plugins.description: Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 对话的任何位置选中文本，附加注释，并将整个批注与下一条消息一同发送。

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud for DeepSeek Harness: one API key, auto-pulled model catalog, real thinking levels, hosted web tools, and 5h/7d quota + token usage UI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama Cloud：一键 API 密钥、自动拉取模型目录、实时推理等级、托管网页工具，以及 5h/7d 配额和 Token 用量 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-tabs
plugins.description: 按照插件分类添加tab页到技能菜单里
plugins.zh: 按照插件分类添加tab页到技能菜单里

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stat
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度、余量提醒、历史用量补录。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度、余量提醒、历史用量补录。

plugins.name: dsh-public-proxy
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes the DSH Web UI for LAN access
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：暴露 DSH Web UI 以供局域网访问

plugins.name: dsh-windows-workspace-guard
plugins.description: Windows agent safety for DeepSeek Harness: preview risky calls, protect workspace boundaries, and explain audit decisions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Windows 代理安全：预览风险调用、保护工作区边界，并解释审计决策

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-status
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a peak/off-peak billing indicator and a live account balance beside the composer. Both self-updating, both credential-free.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：计费峰谷指示器与实时账户余额，显示在编辑器旁。两者均可自动更新且无需凭证。

plugins.name: dsh-sysproxy
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：跟随 Windows 系统代理，带开关
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：跟随 Windows 系统代理，带开关

plugins.name: @aiwayds/dsh-vault
plugins.description: dsh-plugin: encrypted backup / restore / migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：通过私人 GitHub 仓库加密备份/恢复/迁移 dsh 主目录配置

plugins.name: dsh-cron
plugins.description: Cron scheduling for the DeepSeek Harness — bounded tasks with calendar & interval rules, delivered to live agents
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Cron 定时调度——带日历和间隔规则的限制任务，交付给活跃 agent

plugins.name: @aiwayds/dsh-web-search-anysearch
plugins.description: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 AnySearch 网络搜索提供程序插件。

plugins.name: @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry
plugins.description: dsh plugin: bounded retry for transient gateway network failures the stock retry policy cannot classify (finish_reason: network_error, unexpected EOF, TLS alerts, stream read errors)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：为底层重试策略无法分类的临时网关网络故障提供有界重试（finish_reason: network_error, unexpected EOF, TLS 告警, 流读取错误）。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-memories
plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Codex 风格文件化长期记忆：两阶段提取、整合 MEMORY.md 手册、提示注入摘要，以及搜索/读取/列出/笔记工具。

plugins.name: dshbase-catalog
plugins.description: Search the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内部搜索 dshbase 插件目录

plugins.name: dsh-mobile
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: QR pairing, DSH on your phone, answer approvals from notifications.
plugins.zh: DSH Mobile Android 应用专用 DeepSeek Harness 插件：QR 配对、手机上的 DSH、通知中审批回复。

plugins.name: dsh-session-map
plugins.description: Agent Chat 新交互形态——会话图谱画布，分叉、回退、继承关系，一目了然。   Agent Chat's new interaction form—the conversation graph canvas, where branching, rollback, and inheritance relationships are clear at a glance.
plugins.zh: Agent Chat 新交互形态——会话图谱画布，分叉、回退、继承关系，一目了然。   Agent Chat's new interaction form—the conversation graph canvas, where branching, rollback, and inheritance relationships are clear at a glance.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-open-source-first
plugins.description: DSH plugin: injects an auditable open-source-first workflow (search -> three-tier evaluation -> build) into the system prompt at order 50.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在 order 50 处向系统提示注入可审计的开源优先工作流（搜索 -> 三层评估 -> 构建）。

plugins.name: dsh-memos-compat
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.1+ compatibility build of @memtensor/memos-local-plugin — installable via dsh plugin add
plugins.zh: @memtensor/memos-local-plugin 的 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.1+ 兼容构建版——可通过 dsh plugin add 安装

plugins.name: dsh-custom-tool-studio
plugins.description: DSH bundle plugin: author Python tools in the Web UI or through agent tools, register them as first-class DSH tools, gate dangerous runs through built-in approval, group tools into packs.
plugins.zh: DSH 包插件：在 Web UI 或通过代理工具编写 Python 工具，注册为首选 DSH 工具，通过内置审批机制管控危险运行，将工具分组打包。

plugins.name: dsh-combo
plugins.description: PowerMode-style tool-call combo feedback for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop, with a countdown, four effects and live customization.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 和 Desktop 的 PowerMode 风格工具调用连击反馈：含倒计时、四种特效及实时自定义功能。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact
plugins.description: Collapsible OpenCode GO usage widget for DeepSeek Harness: arrow-only footer handle, 5h/weekly/monthly quotas, same-origin proxy. Fork of @astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可折叠 OpenCode GO 用量控件：仅箭头页脚手柄，5h/周/月配额，同源代理。@astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage 的分支。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-lx-music
plugins.description: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词 + 播放控制插件：歌词贴进 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊放上一首/播放暂停/下一首；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它拉起来（托盘启动，不弹窗）。不接管播放。
plugins.zh: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词 + 播放控制插件：歌词贴进 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊放上一首/播放暂停/下一首；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它拉起来（托盘启动，不弹窗）。不接管播放。

plugins.name: dsh-confirm-gate
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, then ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switch without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-only -> full). Crafted on an estimated 0.27 USD of model spend.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 操作闸门：限制每轮持久操作次数，超限时提醒并指示模型停止，随后请求确认。在沙箱/只读模式下自动避让；支持实时权限切换无需重启。已在真实硬件上验证（完整 -> 工作区写入 -> 只读 -> 完整）。基于约 0.27 美元模型消耗开发。

plugins.name: dsh-ask-assistant
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：侧边栏底部动作区加「问助理」按钮，一键用内置浏览器打开 DeepSeek 网页版，随手问事不消耗会话 token。
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：侧边栏底部动作区加「问助理」按钮，一键用内置浏览器打开 DeepSeek 网页版，随手问事不消耗会话 token。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-zeta
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness notification center with interactive Windows question and approval cards
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通知中心，支持交互式 Windows 问答与审批卡片

plugins.name: um-dsh-websearch
plugins.description: Exa (exa.ai) web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): dynamic enabled switch, credentials-service key resolution, bilingual settings card.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 Exa (exa.ai) Web 搜索提供程序插件：动态启用开关、凭据服务密钥解析、双语设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-instruction-memory
plugins.description: DSH instruction memory plugin: maintain long-term instructions in the DSH settings UI, auto-injected into every subsequent conversation's system prompt.
plugins.zh: DSH 指令记忆插件：在 DSH 设置 UI 中维护长期指令，自动注入到后续每条对话的系统提示中。

plugins.name: dsh-pulse
plugins.description: Pulse: a Claude-inspired live status layer for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar - state table, project tabs, live run steps, FLIP transitions.
plugins.zh: Pulse：借鉴 Claude 的 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时状态层——状态表格、项目标签页、实时运行步骤、FLIP 过渡动画。

plugins.name: dsh-live-reload
plugins.description: DSH 免重启热刷新插件：监视插件源码变化，重新加载 host 侧插件模块并刷新 Web 界面，让插件更新立刻生效，无需重启桌面端。
plugins.zh: DSH 免重启热刷新插件：监视插件源码变化，重新加载 host 侧插件模块并刷新 Web 界面，让插件更新立刻生效，无需重启桌面端。

plugins.name: dsh-image-insight
plugins.description: DSH plugin: accurate + fast image insight (local measurement pipeline + DeepSeek vision).
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：准确快速的图像洞察（本地测量管线 + DeepSeek 视觉）。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-set-session-title
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：对话标题工具，支持当前会话命名和历史会话重命名
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：对话标题工具，支持当前会话命名和历史会话重命名

plugins.name: dsh-roles-zeta
plugins.description: Role-based subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness: one delegate tool over a folder of role files
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的基于角色的子智能体委派：针对角色文件文件夹的一个委派工具。

plugins.name: dsh-webchat-bridge
plugins.description: Embed chat.deepseek.com web chat in DSH and transfer the conversation into a workspace session for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中嵌入 chat.deepseek.com 网页聊天，并将对话转移至 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区会话。

plugins.name: @snylonue/dsh-spawn
plugins.description: A tool call for direct argv execution and optional filesystem query tools for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供直接执行 argv 的工具调用，以及可选的文件系统查询工具

plugins.name: @snylonue/dsh-direnv
plugins.description: Workspace-aware direnv environment injection for DeepSeek Harness, with user-approved .envrc authorization
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作空间感知型 direnv 环境注入工具，支持用户审批 .envrc 授权

plugins.name: dsh-gpt-niang-quota
plugins.description: GPT娘额度挂件 by Tokyo — Codex quota monitoring, editable replies and an original draggable mascot for DSH.
plugins.zh: GPT娘额度挂件 by Tokyo — Codex quota monitoring, editable replies and an original draggable mascot for DSH.

plugins.name: skill-use
plugins.description: DSH 插件：Skill 与 MCP 使用审计。扫描 20 类 skill 来源，标注每个 skill 来自哪个工具，在对话顶部状态栏显示真实调用次数、成败、耗时与 MCP 使用。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Skill 与 MCP 使用审计。扫描 20 类 skill 来源，标注每个 skill 来自哪个工具，在对话顶部状态栏显示真实调用次数、成败、耗时与 MCP 使用。

plugins.name: dsh-takeover
plugins.description: DSH 会话接力插件：拉取八家 agent 会话（/resume-*）、寄存当前会话（/handoff）、开局取件（/inbox），落在 handoff: 1 开放协议上
plugins.zh: DSH 会话接力插件：拉取八家 agent 会话（/resume-*）、寄存当前会话（/handoff）、开局取件（/inbox），落在 handoff: 1 开放协议上

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-free
plugins.description: 这是一个零配置即可用在DSH harness当中，免费使用opencode免费模型的插件
plugins.zh: 这是一个零配置即可用在DSH harness当中，免费使用opencode免费模型的插件

plugins.name: dsh-boo550wt-animation
plugins.description: 550W-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: play a video full-screen when DSH opens, and reveal the UI only after it finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 550W 风格启动动画：DSH 打开时全屏播放视频，播放完毕后再显示界面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-brave-cdp
plugins.description: DSH tools that drive your running Brave browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol
plugins.zh: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 驱动运行中 Brave 浏览器的 DSH 工具

plugins.name: dsh-macos-notify
plugins.description: Native interactive macOS notifications, approvals and full question forms for DeepSeek Harness Desktop
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供原生交互式 macOS 通知、审批及完整问卷表单。

plugins.name: dsh-tandem
plugins.description: 双 agent 协作 DSH 插件：主 agent 负责跟你沟通与决策，本地 Codex(GPT) 负责并行执行与方案会审。任务缺验收标准直接拒绝派发。
plugins.zh: 双 agent 协作 DSH 插件：主 agent 负责跟你沟通与决策，本地 Codex(GPT) 负责并行执行与方案会审。任务缺验收标准直接拒绝派发。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-icon-row
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn sidebar entries into a compact icon row, with adjustable icon size and per-entry visibility.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将侧边栏条目转换为紧凑图标行，支持调整图标大小和单个条目的可见性。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-adapt
plugins.description: DSH web client plugin: mobile/touch adaptation for the DSH web UI (drawer sidebar, floating opener, layering contract, probe-verified).
plugins.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件：针对 DSH Web UI 的移动端/触屏适配（抽屉式侧边栏、浮动开启按钮、层级协议、探针验证）。

plugins.name: dsh-context-dashboard
plugins.description: Sidebar context/billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: live context ring, per-session usage & spend, account balance and token-plan quota readouts across configured LLM channels.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏上下文/计费仪表盘：实时上下文环、按会话用量与支出、账户余额及各 LLM 通道的令牌计划配额读数。

plugins.name: DSH-One-Dark-Pro-Theme
plugins.description: One Dark Pro (classic) theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a Settings -> General switcher with a full 156-token override layer, 1:1 colors from the VS Code extension.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 One Dark Pro (经典) 主题：Settings -> General 切换器，含完整的 156-token 覆盖层，颜色与 VS Code 扩展 1:1 一致。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-sync
plugins.description: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home to your own private git repository. Cross-platform, configurable, never silent about failures.
plugins.zh: 自动对 DeepSeek Harness 主目录进行版本化备份至你的私有 Git 仓库。跨平台，可配置，失败时明确提示。

plugins.name: dsh-free-egg-credits
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在界面中显示 WorkBuddy / Qoder 反代网关账号的可用积分、每日签到状态与本会话消耗积分。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在界面中显示 WorkBuddy / Qoder 反代网关账号的可用积分、每日签到状态与本会话消耗积分。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-lab
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：10 套内置主题，自由搭配配色、背景与风格，支持自定义图片和一键恢复官方外观。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：10 套内置主题，自由搭配配色、背景与风格，支持自定义图片和一键恢复官方外观。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-picker
plugins.description: Agent 模式选择器：像推理档位那样选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code / Codex / Qwen / Gemini / Aider / Goose / Hermes / OpenClaw / Ollama…）作为默认执行体。Agent 目录是数据驱动的：加一个新 Agent 只需加一条数据，不必改代码。
plugins.zh: Agent 模式选择器：像推理档位那样选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code / Codex / Qwen / Gemini / Aider / Goose / Hermes / OpenClaw / Ollama…）作为默认执行体。Agent 目录是数据驱动的：加一个新 Agent 只需加一条数据，不必改代码。

plugins.name: dsh-dual-bridge

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid-plus
plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, theme-aware, fullscreen zoom viewer

Two gates (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done) are enforced by the board itself, and every move is an event, so cycle time and throughput come from what happened.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-session-delete
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: permanently delete a session from the sidebar session menu - stops running work first, refuses forked parents, and clears every local storage surface.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从侧边栏会话菜单中永久删除会话——先停止正在运行的工作，拒绝分叉父级会话，并清除所有本地存储。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-subagent-report
plugins.description: The child-scoped report tool for continuable in-process subagents on DeepSeek Harness: installs `report` plus its usage guidance into every continuable child scope, so findings reach the parent before the child finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上可续接的子代理专用报告工具：将 `report` 及其使用指南安装至每个可续接子作用域，确保在子代理结束前将发现结果反馈给父代理。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-edit
plugins.description: The rich `edit` tool for DeepSeek Harness (replace / patch / apply_patch / hashline modes) with embedded format-on-write and diagnostics — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的丰富 `edit` 工具（replace / patch / apply_patch / hashline 模式），嵌入写入时格式化与诊断——独立插件，无需修改上游 harness。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-debug
plugins.description: Model-facing Debug Adapter Protocol debug tool with 28 operations (launch/attach, breakpoints, stepping, threads/stack/scopes/variables/evaluate, disassembly, memory, terminate) over the standalone DAP seam — no harness changes required.
plugins.zh: 面向模型的调试适配器协议（DAP）调试工具，提供 28 种操作（启动/附加、断点、单步执行、线程/栈/作用域/变量/求值、反汇编、内存、终止），通过独立的 DAP 接口运行，无需修改 Harness。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-codebase-memory
plugins.description: 14 model-facing codebase-memory tools — search_graph, query_graph, trace_path, snippets, architecture, search_code, detect_changes, ADRs, and more — one-shot queries against the codebase-memory daemon; the local alternative to a stdio MCP client row.
plugins.zh: 14 个面向模型的代码库内存工具——search_graph、query_graph、trace_path、snippets、architecture、search_code、detect_changes、ADRs 等——对代码库内存守护进程进行一次性查询；作为本地替代方案，取代 stdio MCP 客户端行。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-ast
plugins.description: The ast_grep (structural code search) and ast_edit (structural rewrite) tools for DeepSeek Harness over the packaged ast-grep native engine — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-session-url
plugins.description: session:// internal-URL scheme handler: read a session transcript, read one event as JSON, list sessions, and search past history through internal-URL-aware read/grep tools — standalone for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: session:// 内部 URL 方案处理器：读取会话记录、以 JSON 格式读取单个事件、列出会话，并通过支持内部 URL 的 read/grep 工具搜索历史——DeepSeek Harness 独立运行。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.description: Agent-curated long-horizon memory for DeepSeek Harness: durable project-scoped memory banks (ctx.memory) with a provider registry + model-facing retain/recall/reflect/learn tools.
plugins.zh: Agent 管理的 DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆：持久化项目级记忆库（ctx.memory），含提供商注册表 + 面向模型的保留/召回/反思/学习工具。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-internal-urls
plugins.description: FS-shaped internal URL schemes (conflict://, pr://, issue://, …) resolved through one registry behind the read/grep/write tools — a standalone service plugin for DeepSeek Harness with no upstream harness changes required.
plugins.zh: FS 风格的内部 URL 方案（conflict://、pr://、issue:// 等），由单一注册表在 read/grep/write 工具后统一解析；作为独立服务插件接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需修改上游 Harness。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-code-runtime-kernels
plugins.description: The run_kernel_code tool for DeepSeek Harness: persistent Python and JavaScript kernels (a long-lived python3/node subprocess per session, sharing a core host driver) — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 run_kernel_code 工具：持久化 Python 和 JavaScript 内核（每个会话一个长生命周期的 python3/node 子进程，共享核心主机驱动）——独立插件，无需上游 Harness 改动

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Automic Vault 支持：host ctx.av 服务（CLI 解析与探测、通过子进程接口进行扫描/诊断/检测器/加固器/列表操作），为 @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-av 中的 vault 工具提供支持，无需修改 Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-hosts

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：连接装了 host_server_mcp 的服务器，在 Web 设置页配置（IP/主机名 + 端口 + token），之后 agent 对话里即可访问这些服务器排查问题——查看信息、执行脚本、读文件、一键诊断。

plugins.name: dsh-model-fallback

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spreadjs-driver
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: allow the agent editing XLSX/SJS/SSJSON file automaticlly, can be cooperated with dsh-spreadjs-editor plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：允许代理自动编辑 XLSX/SJS/SSJSON 文件，可与 dsh-spreadjs-editor 插件配合使用。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spreadjs-editor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: view and edit Excel/SpreadJS workbooks from the ui-all file tree.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：从 ui-all 文件树中查看和编辑 Excel/SpreadJS 工作簿。

plugins.name: dsh-lmmarr
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态

plugins.name: dsh-skill-market
plugins.description: DSH 可视化技能商店 — Visual skill market inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, install and manage Agent Skills
plugins.zh: DSH 可视化技能商店 — Visual skill market inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, install and manage Agent Skills

plugins.name: dsh-worktree-guard
plugins.description: Git worktree guard for DeepSeek Harness: session-rooted isolation, always-on git safety net, mechanical human gate
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 工作树防护：会话根目录隔离、常驻 git 安全网、机械式人工门禁

plugins.name: dsh-open-native
plugins.description: Open delivered-file cards with the system default app
plugins.zh: 使用系统默认应用打开已交付的文件卡片

plugins.name: dsh-launch-card
plugins.description: 发布卡片：从本地仓库真实产物生成 hero 图、特性网格与双语文案，导出前 lint 掉无法证实的说法
plugins.zh: 发布卡片：从本地仓库真实产物生成 hero 图、特性网格与双语文案，导出前 lint 掉无法证实的说法

plugins.name: dsh-turing-table
plugins.description: 图灵圆桌：若干座位由不同模型配置的 agent 扮演，靠提问与交叉印证找出哪些座位是 AI，每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录
plugins.zh: 图灵圆桌：若干座位由不同模型配置的 agent 扮演，靠提问与交叉印证找出哪些座位是 AI，每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录

plugins.name: dsh-ship-receipt
plugins.description: A shareable delivery receipt for DeepSeek Harness: branch and commit, artifact hashes, the three pre-push checks and your test/build results, hard-split into verified / local-only / unverified with blank slots instead of prose.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可共享交付收据：分支与提交、制品哈希、三个预推送检查及你的测试/构建结果，硬拆分至已验证/仅本地/未验证，用空白槽位代替文本描述。

plugins.name: dsh-signal-pet
plugins.description: A status pet for DeepSeek Harness: reacts to the real session event stream (thinking, tool calls, errors, long-job completion) and doubles as a busy/error indicator you can see at a glance.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的状态宠物：响应真实会话事件流（思考、工具调用、错误、长任务完成），同时作为一眼可辨的忙碌/错误指示器。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-diff
plugins.description: Pixel-level screenshot diff for DeepSeek Harness: two local PNGs in, a PIXEL_CHANGED verdict, difference regions and a self-contained HTML comparison page out. Zero dependencies, fully local.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 像素级截图对比：输入两张本地 PNG，输出 PIXEL_CHANGED 判定、差异区域及自包含 HTML 对比页面。零依赖，完全本地运行。

plugins.name: dsh-icon-switch
plugins.description: dsh-icon-switch: in-app icon switcher for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: dsh-icon-switch：DeepSeek Harness 内置图标切换器

plugins.name: dsh-litellm-extra-headers
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为指定的提供者和上游主机，在 OpenAI 兼容的 chat/completions 请求中注入 body-level 额外头部（这是唯一能穿透 LiteLLM 中继的注入点）。

plugins.name: dsh-test-framework
plugins.description: 面向测试工程师的 DSH 插件：把空文件夹一键变成「测试工作框架」骨架，并在 AI 会话里带上框架约束 —— 需求文档拆模块 / 确认版本 / 跨文档关联 / 登记测试环境与账密。AI test-framework plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 面向测试工程师的 DSH 插件：把空文件夹一键变成「测试工作框架」骨架，并在 AI 会话里带上框架约束 —— 需求文档拆模块 / 确认版本 / 跨文档关联 / 登记测试环境与账密。AI test-framework plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-cpp-optimization
plugins.description: DSH 技能插件：按目标工程真实 C++ 标准审查代码，覆盖 RAII 与所有权、移动语义与值类别、异常安全、性能与内存、并发安全、编译期与 ABI；默认先出报告、用户确认后才改代码。
plugins.zh: DSH 技能插件：按目标工程真实 C++ 标准审查代码，覆盖 RAII 与所有权、移动语义与值类别、异常安全、性能与内存、并发安全、编译期与 ABI；默认先出报告、用户确认后才改代码。

plugins.name: dsh-milestone-guard
plugins.description: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (阶段性结论软强制守卫插件)
plugins.zh: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (阶段性结论软强制守卫插件)

plugins.name: dsh-strata-monitor
plugins.description: Strata model server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness: monitor page, floating window, composer status line.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Strata 模型服务器监控面板：监控页面、浮动窗口、Composer 状态栏。

plugins.name: dsh-group-status
plugins.description: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。
plugins.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。

plugins.name: dsh-undici-timeout
plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness LLM 出口的可选直连通道：可配置的 keep-alive undici Agent，支持调整连接/头部/主体/保活超时、强制 IPv4、默认关闭 HTTP/2、代理后自动降级，以及只读状态路由。最小化补丁，单文件，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-edit-resend
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: edit an already-sent user prompt and resend it - forks a child session whose inherited prefix stops just before that message.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：编辑已发送的用户提示词并重新发送——分叉一个子会话，其继承前缀仅截止到该消息之前。

plugins.name: dsh-firefly-spring-skin
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI

plugins.name: dsh-tab-groups
plugins.description: Edge/Chrome extension that auto-groups every DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI tab, plus the DSH plugin that mirrors it to a fixed path, detects it inside the GUI and drives it. One package, two faces.
plugins.zh: Edge/Chrome 扩展：自动将每个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 标签页归类，并搭配相应 DSH 插件将其镜像到固定路径，在 GUI 内检测并驱动该路径。一套安装包，两种形态。

plugins.name: dsh-omni-modal
plugins.description: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness: configure OpenAI-compatible image/video generation endpoints with switchable config profiles, plus generate_image / generate_video / check_video tools.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Omni-modal 设置部分：配置 OpenAI 兼容的图像/视频生成端点，支持可切换的配置方案，并提供 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-huoqu
plugins.description: DSH desktop plugin: capture a rendered webpage into a local offline HTML and MHTML copy.
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：将渲染后的网页捕获为本地离线 HTML 和 MHTML 副本。

plugins.name: dsh-easy-hotkey
plugins.description: Window-local shortcut guide for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: hold-to-open overlay, keycap search, temporary pinning, light/dark themes, and bilingual UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 窗口级快捷键指南：按住打开浮层、键帽搜索、临时固定、明暗主题及双语界面。

plugins.name: dsh-herdr-site
plugins.description: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr，支持面板跳转与 --wait。状态上报 / 终端集成。｜ Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state, enabling panel jump and --wait support.
plugins.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr，支持面板跳转与 --wait。状态上报 / 终端集成。｜ Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state, enabling panel jump and --wait support.

plugins.name: dsh-glm-quota-dock
plugins.description: GLM Coding Plan quota pill for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - real-time per-window usage in the composer stats row
plugins.zh: GLM Coding Plan 配额指示器，用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI —— 在 Composer 统计栏中实时显示每窗口用量。

plugins.name: dsh-projection-persist
plugins.description: DSH plugin: keep session projection values (titles) alive across a Host generation reset, so the session list never falls back to the untitled placeholder.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：保持会话投影值（标题）在主机生成重置后依然存活，使会话列表不再回退到「未命名」占位符。

plugins.name: dsh-yandex-browser
plugins.description: DSH plugin: persistent Yandex Browser profile for the agent plus tools to read and drive pages over CDP
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：智能体的持久化 Yandex Browser 配置文件，以及通过 CDP 读取和操控页面的工具。

plugins.name: dsh-tmp-wks
plugins.description: Stop leaving DSH to make a temp folder. One-click throwaway workspaces with optional cleanup · 告别手动建目录，DSH 一键临时工作区，删除可控
plugins.zh: Stop leaving DSH to make a temp folder. One-click throwaway workspaces with optional cleanup · 告别手动建目录，DSH 一键临时工作区，删除可控

plugins.name: dsh-share-room
plugins.description: Invite others into your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) AI conversation: they join from a link, discuss with you and ask the AI together. No account needed.
plugins.zh: 邀请他人加入你的 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) AI 对话：对方通过链接加入，与你及 AI 共同讨论。无需账户。

plugins.name: dsh-side-chat
plugins.description: Temporary side conversations for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 和 Web 的临时侧边对话

plugins.name: dsh-db-connections
plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命名数据库连接——在设置页面配置 MySQL，随后在聊天中通过名称引用。默认只读，写操作需逐连接单独启用。

plugins.name: dsh-aux-degrade
plugins.description: DSH 1.5 辅助模型降级：让压缩摘要、会话标题这类旁路调用更省更完整，主循环零影响。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Auxiliary-model degradation for DSH 1.5: cheaper, complete side calls (reasoning off, token floor, tools stripped). DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.zh: DSH 1.5 辅助模型降级：让压缩摘要、会话标题这类旁路调用更省更完整，主循环零影响。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Auxiliary-model degradation for DSH 1.5: cheaper, complete side calls (reasoning off, token floor, tools stripped). DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.

plugins.name: dsh-capability-composer
plugins.description: DSH 1.5 能力组合器：按会话或工作区编排工具、技能与 MCP，按需缩小系统提示。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Capability composer for DSH 1.5: per-session tool / skill / MCP compositions that shrink the system prompt on demand. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.zh: DSH 1.5 能力组合器：按会话或工作区编排工具、技能与 MCP，按需缩小系统提示。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Capability composer for DSH 1.5: per-session tool / skill / MCP compositions that shrink the system prompt on demand. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.

plugins.name: dsh-req-capture
plugins.description: Diagnostic plugin: wraps global fetch to log requests and capture bodies whose URL matches a configurable substring to disk.
plugins.zh: 诊断插件：包装全局 fetch，记录请求并捕获 URL 匹配可配置子串的主体内容到磁盘。

plugins.name: dsh-compaction-codex
plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.zh: Codex 风格的窗口交换压缩引擎：基于确定性指针模板生成摘要，零 LLM 调用，替代默认的 LLM 摘要压缩方案。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-commands
plugins.description: Smarter slash-command matching for skills: suffix, contains and alias matching (e.g. /studio finds autonomous-studio).
plugins.zh: 更智能的技能斜杠命令匹配：支持后缀、包含和别名匹配（例如 /studio 可匹配 autonomous-studio）。

plugins.name: dsh-active-sessions
plugins.description: Sidebar tab listing running and completed-unread sessions across projects, with click-to-switch and grouping.
plugins.zh: 侧边栏选项卡，列出各项目下运行中和已完成但未读的会话，支持点击切换和分组显示。

plugins.name: dsh-en2zh
plugins.description: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
plugins.zh: Web UI 中模型输出的实时英译中：译文在上，原文保留在侧，可选本地机器翻译引擎与 LLM 后备方案。

plugins.name: dsh-context-budget
plugins.description: Ports the Codex CLI TokenBudget mechanism to dsh: remaining-context awareness, archive rollover, and notes/history retrieval tools for past sessions.
plugins.zh: 将 Codex CLI TokenBudget 机制移植到 dsh：具备剩余上下文感知、归档轮换，以及过去会话的笔记/历史检索工具。

plugins.name: dsh-resource-lease
plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.zh: 资源租赁治理：自动注册浏览器标签页、后台作业、进程和端口为会话拥有的租赁，支持 TTL 自动回收、固定保留和手动清理。

plugins.name: tokens_DshWebSearch_code
plugins.description: Zero-config web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness with automatic provider fallback.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 零配置网页搜索插件，支持自动供应商故障转移。

plugins.name: muche-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: 连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
plugins.zh: 连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务

plugins.name: dsh-auto-maximize
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮） | DeepSeek Harness Desktop Plugin: Auto‑maximize main window on launch (same as clicking the Maximize button manually)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮） | DeepSeek Harness Desktop Plugin: Auto‑maximize main window on launch (same as clicking the Maximize button manually)

plugins.name: dsh-guild-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges a guild expert-team board into dsh: routes guild tasks to one-shot dsh subagents, visible in the GUI.
plugins.zh: 将公会专家团队看板接入 dsh：将公会任务路由至一次性 dsh 子代理，并在 GUI 中显示。

plugins.name: dsh-mac-notify
plugins.description: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
plugins.zh: macOS 桌面通知，通过 SSH 发送给在 Mac 上运行的小型通知者 HTTP 监听器，用于 dsh 事件。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-duck
plugins.description: Web search provider that bridges an OpenAI Responses-API-compatible endpoint with the web_search_preview tool into the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 网络搜索提供者：将兼容 OpenAI Responses API 的端点与 web_search_preview 工具桥接至 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-bing
plugins.description: Keyless Bing HTML search provider plus a relay-aware fetch provider with per-hop redirect validation for the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 无密钥 Bing HTML 搜索提供者，以及支持逐跳重定向验证的 relay-aware 获取提供者，用于 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-ttft-hedge
plugins.description: Hedged requests for streaming /v1/messages LLM calls: fires a second attempt when response headers miss a deadline and races them, retries immediately on 5xx/504, passes through 4xx/429, with statistics.
plugins.zh: 针对流式 /v1/messages LLM 调用的 hedged 请求：当响应头未按时到达时触发第二次尝试并竞争返回，对 5xx/504 立即重试，透传 4xx/429，并附带统计信息。

plugins.name: dsh-stream-index-guard
plugins.description: Patches the LLM assistant-stream accumulator at runtime to clamp invalid chunk indices, downgrading hard stream failures to dropped or merged chunks; ships a stats tool.
plugins.zh: 在运行时修补 LLM 助理流累加器以钳位无效 chunk 索引，将严重的流故障降级为丢弃或合并的 chunk；附带统计工具。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-suite
plugins.description: Session hygiene suite: strips leaked thinking tags, adds retry cooldown budgets, blocks plaintext credentials before execution, runs a daily health-check loop with a health panel, and auto-tunes agent instruction hints from error statistics.
plugins.zh: 会话清理套件：清除泄露的 thinking 标签、增加重试冷却预算、在执行前拦截明文凭证、运行每日健康检查循环并配有健康面板，以及基于错误统计自动优化代理指令提示。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-watch
plugins.description: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
plugins.zh: 浮动叠加层，集中展示来自任意会话的待审批项、计划审查和用户问题，支持点击进入对应会话。

plugins.name: dsh-super-injector
plugins.description: Runtime plugin injector: inject, hot-reload and uninstall local plugin packages in a running dsh without restarts, with plugin scaffolding, self-test and a management panel.
plugins.zh: 运行时插件注入器：无需重启即可在运行的 dsh 中注入、热重载和卸载本地插件包，支持插件脚手架、自测及管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-terminal
plugins.description: Claude Code-style terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 风格的 Claude Code 终端 UI 插件

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-categories
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区分类树：分类 > 工作区 > 会话（VS Code 风格）。Collapsible category tree for DSH workspaces.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区分类树：分类 > 工作区 > 会话（VS Code 风格）。Collapsible category tree for DSH workspaces.

plugins.name: dsh-almazom-approve-escalate
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: one-click Approve & escalate on the approval card — approves the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：一键审批并升级 — 批准待处理请求并将实时会话切换至权限预设

plugins.name: dsh-conflict-doctor
plugins.description: DSH plugin conflict governance: diagnose silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and get the exact patch that fixes each one. DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。
plugins.zh: DSH plugin conflict governance: diagnose silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and get the exact patch that fixes each one. DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。

plugins.name: dsh-cache-report
plugins.description: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
plugins.zh: 查看是什么消耗了你的提示词缓存。DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 命中率与工具块成本报告——零依赖，不注册任何工具。

plugins.name: dsh-git-view
plugins.description: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息
plugins.zh: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息

plugins.name: dsh-image-compare
plugins.description: Sidebar image comparer for DeepSeek Harness: browse the session workspace inside the right-column panel, open a set of images into one pageable viewer, zoom and pan each image independently, sync one view onto the whole set, and reorder them by dragging the filmstrip.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏图像对比器：在右列面板内浏览会话工作区，将一组图片打开到同一可翻页查看器，独立缩放和平移每张图像，同步其中一视图至整组，并通过拖动胶卷条重新排序

plugins.name: dsh-provider-fold
plugins.description: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 模型选择菜单支持折叠式提供商分组和显眼的提供商标题。

plugins.name: spa-api-extract
plugins.description: Agent Skill: extract data from JS single-page apps via curl+grep+python when WebFetch fails (timeout / obfuscated JS). Read-only, desensitized, MIT.
plugins.zh: Agent Skill：当 WebFetch 失败（超时/混淆 JS）时，通过 curl+grep+python 从 JS 单页应用提取数据。只读、脱敏，采用 MIT 许可证。

plugins.name: dsh-quota-pill
plugins.description: DSH plugin: DeepSeek account balance and per-Session spend in the composer dock
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：DeepSeek 账户余额及单会话开销显示于 Composer 停靠栏

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qq-bot
plugins.description: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.
plugins.zh: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.

plugins.name: dsh-smart-ui
plugins.description: Render AI answers as interactive UI cards in DSH: comparisons, charts, diagrams, tables, calculators and unit conversions. The model writes a JSON spec — never markup.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中将 AI 回答渲染为交互式 UI 卡片：支持对比、图表、 diagrams、表格、计算器和单位换算。模型仅输出 JSON 规范，不输出标记语言。

plugins.name: dsh-inquiry-preset
plugins.description: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）
plugins.zh: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）

plugins.name: dsh-goal-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: hold back goal auto-continuation while background subagents are still running (in-process disarm/resume guard), so a delegated turn does not burn <goal_round> injections while it waits for settlement.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：当后台子代理仍在运行时暂停目标自动继续（进程内禁用/恢复守卫），以免委托轮次在等待结算过程中消耗 <goal_round> 注入次数

plugins.name: @lemoncat7/dsh-remote-settings-compat
plugins.description: Unified trusted settings and password access gateway for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的统一可信设置与密码访问网关。

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.
plugins.zh: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.

plugins.name: dsh-computer-mcp
plugins.description: 通过 MCP 让 DeepSeek Harness 操作另一台电脑：文件读写、搜索、编辑、回收与可选命令执行，支持 Windows/macOS 和内网/Tailscale。
plugins.zh: 通过 MCP 让 DeepSeek Harness 操作另一台电脑：文件读写、搜索、编辑、回收与可选命令执行，支持 Windows/macOS 和内网/Tailscale。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-group
plugins.description: Selection Toolbar (dsh-selection-group) — one hover toolbar for text selected in DeepSeek Harness: annotate + quote in a single box, depending on neither upstream plugin.
plugins.zh: 选区工具栏 (dsh-selection-group) —— DeepSeek Harness 中选中文本时出现的一个悬停工具栏：在一个框内同时完成标注与引用，不依赖上游插件。

plugins.name: dsh-anysearch-fallback
plugins.description: DSH web_fetch fallback: when AnySearch extraction fails with HTTP 422, the page is fetched directly with a browser-like user agent. Zero-dependency DSH plugin.
plugins.zh: DSH web_fetch 回退方案：当 AnySearch 因 HTTP 422 提取失败时，使用类似浏览器的 User-Agent 直接抓取页面。零依赖 DSH 插件

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-paopaocat
plugins.description: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。
plugins.zh: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-delta
plugins.description: 给 AI 编码助手的跨会话长期记忆：自动注入、只推变化。DSH 插件 + 零依赖 CLI。
plugins.zh: 给 AI 编码助手的跨会话长期记忆：自动注入、只推变化。DSH 插件 + 零依赖 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-gh-trending
plugins.description: dsh 插件：GitHub 日/周/月热榜监控 + 仓库详情中文描述与 README 节译（全程只读 GET）
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：GitHub 日/周/月热榜监控 + 仓库详情中文描述与 README 节译（全程只读 GET）

plugins.name: dsh-restart-button
plugins.description: A button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.
plugins.zh: 侧边栏底部的按钮，用于重启 DSH 桌面应用并在其返回时重新加载页面。

plugins.name: dsh-bonk-pet
plugins.description: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭
plugins.zh: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-spend
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: real OpenRouter spend — today's cost under the composer, per-key and per-model analytics and prepaid balance in Settings. Install: dsh plugin add dsh-openrouter-spend
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示真实的 OpenRouter 消费情况——Composer 下方的当日费用、按密钥和模型分析以及预付款余额。安装命令：dsh plugin add dsh-openrouter-spend

plugins.name: dsh-loop-guard
plugins.description: DSH 插件：每次工具调用前拦一道，认出同一个错误反复出现、两个工具乒乓互指、会话跨轮烧钱到线 —— 并且绝不把 agent 永久锁死。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：每次工具调用前拦一道，认出同一个错误反复出现、两个工具乒乓互指、会话跨轮烧钱到线 —— 并且绝不把 agent 永久锁死。

plugins.name: dsh-companion
plugins.description: Local state-aware desktop companion and task-status overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地状态感知桌面伴侣和任务状态浮层。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-auto-retry
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: takes over a model-request failure the built-in retry executor declined, continues its backoff curve, and shows the full error the transcript discards.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：接管内置重试执行器拒绝处理的模型请求失败，继续其后退曲线，并显示转录日志中舍弃的完整错误信息。

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-web-gateway
plugins.description: Resilient web search and page extract tools for DeepSeek Harness with Tavily / Brave / Firecrawl / Exa / SearXNG / DuckDuckGo fallback chain, circuit breaker and SSRF-safe extract.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供坚韧的网络搜索与页面提取工具，支持 Tavily / Brave / Firecrawl / Exa / SearXNG / DuckDuckGo 降级链、熔断机制及防 SSRF 安全提取。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a session cost chip in the conversation header - live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：会话费用芯片——对话头部实时显示按桶计量的令牌用量、高峰/低谷电价及下一档位切换倒计时

plugins.name: dsh-bupt-ucloud
plugins.description: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件
plugins.zh: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的问题报告与诊断遥测工具，支持 AI 优化、问题监控和一键更新

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-usage-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a malformed token-usage sample from taking a whole session history down with it: a missing or non-numeric counter becomes zero before the harness adds it up, so the fold never yields NaN and already-broken sessions open again.
plugins.zh: 防止格式错误的 token 用量样本拖垮整个会话历史：缺失或非数字的计数器在汇总前会被归零，从而避免折叠产生 NaN，已损坏的会话得以重新打开。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比

plugins.name: dsh-pet-progress
plugins.description: Progress companion for the dsh web pet: folds durable todo/write and goal/change session events into the pet's status bubble, so it reports how much work is left - not just what the model is doing right now.
plugins.zh: dsh web pet 的进度伴侣：将持久的 todo/write 和 goal/change 会话事件折叠进宠物状态气泡，使其报告剩余工作量，而非仅显示模型当前的动作

plugins.name: dsh-handoff
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）

plugins.zh: 每个 ArtCraft（故事化创作）应用均作为 DSH 插件——12 个 Cordis 插件驱动 CADCraft、GridCraft、SoundCraft 等 11 个应用，各自通过独立的 CLI 和 MCP 服务器无头运行。

plugins.name: dsh-minimax-tts
plugins.description: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）

plugins.name: dsh-daily-chat-config

plugins.zh: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件

plugins.name: dsh-sci-viz
plugins.description: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。
plugins.zh: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-bridge
plugins.description: Codex architect and read-only reviewer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. ChatGPT sign-in, model selection, explicit file approval and checkpoints. Preview.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的 Codex 架构师与只读审查器。支持 ChatGPT 登录、模型选择、显式文件审批及检查点。预览版。

plugins.description: Audio-reactive turn rail for DeepSeek Harness: the transcript's own turn marks dance to whatever the system is playing (WASAPI loopback), with hover-only highlighting and a left/right rail option.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的音频反应式对话轨道：转录本的对话标记随系统播放内容（WASAPI 回环）而动，悬停高亮，支持左右轨道选项。

plugins.name: dsh-codebase-memory
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connects the codebase-memory-mcp code graph, nudges the model at the decision point, corrects failed MCP calls, and indexes repositories by itself.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：连接 codebase-memory-mcp 代码图，在决策点提示模型，纠正失败的 MCP 调用，并自动索引代码仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-eraser
plugins.description: 一款用于DeepSeek Harness的上下文管理插件，可删除单轮/多轮对话，可追溯，npm包同名
plugins.zh: 一款用于DeepSeek Harness的上下文管理插件，可删除单轮/多轮对话，可追溯，npm包同名

plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar

plugins.name: dsh-remote-gui
plugins.description: Embed a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, with remote session listing and local/remote switching.
plugins.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道将远程 DeepSeek Harness GUI 嵌入本地 DSH 窗口，支持远程会话列表与本地/远程切换。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: install, repair or remove the Linux desktop entrance for the Web GUI from inside the harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从 harness 内部安装、修复或移除 Web GUI 的 Linux 桌面入口。

plugins.name: dsh-github-sync
plugins.description: GitHub repository sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): bidirectional git sync with pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring, repo add/remove/rename, local file browsing.
