plugins.name: dsh-session-mover
plugins.description: DSH plugin: move sessions between workspaces safely — frame-level zstd header rewrite, byte-level verification, full-directory backup, live membership update
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：安全地在工作区之间迁移会话——基于帧级的 zstd 头部重写、字节级校验、全目录备份及实时成员更新

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation for real: a Session sidebar action that removes the stored log, its projection cache and its subagent logs.
plugins.zh: 彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：通过 Session 侧边栏操作移除存储的日志、投影缓存及其子代理日志。

plugins.zh: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web

plugins.description: deepseek harness中workspace write权限的增强插件。使用前请自行评估风险。
plugins.zh: deepseek harness中workspace write权限的增强插件。使用前请自行评估风险。

plugins.name: dsh-keep-going
plugins.description: Restart DSH, then carry on: the answer in progress finishes, DSH closes in an orderly way, and every conversation the restart interrupted is woken.
plugins.zh: 重启 DSH，然后继续：进行中的回答完成，DSH 有序关闭，所有因重启中断的会话将被唤醒。

plugins.name: dsh-http-probe

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：http_probe 工具——检查任意 HTTP 端点的状态、延迟和响应头。

plugins.zh: 在 DSH 输入框实时显示 OCG 使用情况的插件。

plugins.zh: LobsterAIDaddy — draggable floating ball + slide-in drawer embedding the LobsterDaddy multi-account console in DSH, with a loopback-only same-origin reverse proxy, live status dot, account badge and a resizable persisted drawer. 把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面悬浮球：可拖拽摆位并记忆，抽屉内嵌完整网页控制台，免退出并行登录/自动签到/积分额度/一键切号。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-favorites-forge
plugins.description: Favorites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favourites filter for DSH conversations — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive feature, editing no official file. 为 DSH 对话增加收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选。

plugins.name: dsh-babel

plugins.name: dsh-codex-session
plugins.description: DSH desktop plugin: choose a DSH-default or Codex session at new-session time. Codex sessions keep the DSH agent loop, tools, approval and UI, served by the locally authenticated Codex App Server.
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：新建会话时选择 DSH 默认会话或 Codex 会话。Codex 会话保留 DSH 智能体循环、工具、审批和 UI，由本地认证通过的 Codex App Server 提供服务。

plugins.name: dsh-webdav-sync

plugins.description: Desktop Control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot and window listing, plus real mouse and keyboard control — with safety gates and a settings card to turn input off. Windows only.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面控制插件：支持截图和窗口列表展示，并提供真实的鼠标与键盘控制 —— 配备安全门控和设置卡片以关闭输入。仅限 Windows。

plugins.name: dsh-context-continuum
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩从「滚动重写的叙事摘要」改成「只追加的会话索引」；三条实测缺陷已取证，征集社区修复。
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩从「滚动重写的叙事摘要」改成「只追加的会话索引」；三条实测缺陷已取证，征集社区修复。

plugins.name: dsh-ASD-100
plugins.description: Always-on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English output for DSH. Commands: /ste on, /ste off, /ste.
plugins.zh: DSH 的常驻 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语输出。命令：/ste on、/ste off、/ste。

plugins.name: dsh-ghidra
plugins.description: Ghidra bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 218 reverse-engineering tools, single-JVM unified mode, in-tree Ghidra install, Settings UI with doctor/download/folder picker.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 Ghidra 桥接插件：集成 218 款逆向工程工具，单 JVM 统一模式，内置 Ghidra 安装，提供包含医生检查/下载/文件夹选择器的设置 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-model-in-use
plugins.description: 标记正在被其他会话占用的模型，记住每个模型的推理档位与分组折叠状态。
plugins.zh: 标记正在被其他会话占用的模型，记住每个模型的推理档位与分组折叠状态。

plugins.name: ccreach-dsh-web-search
plugins.description: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. Lets agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows with source evidence and access conditions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 CCReach 能力搜索提供商，帮助代理发现数据源、工具、API、MCP 服务器、技能与工作流，附带来源证据与访问条件。

plugins.name: dsh-recent
plugins.description: The dsh web GUI sidebar gains a Codex-style 最近 (Recent) section — every workspace's newest sessions in one jump list — and the workspace list folds to the five folders with the newest history
plugins.zh: The dsh web GUI sidebar gains a Codex-style 最近 (Recent) section — every workspace's newest sessions in one jump list — and the workspace list folds to the five folders with the newest history

plugins.name: dsh-bg

plugins.name: dsh-session-eva-status
plugins.description: DSH plugin: colors sidebar session rows by their official status in an Evangelion-flavored palette - orange = pending interaction, red = selected session, purple = finished but unviewed, rainbow title = pinned.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：以新世纪福音战士风格配色按官方状态为侧边栏会话行着色——橙色=待处理交互，红色=选中会话，紫色=已完成但未查看，彩虹标题=置顶。

plugins.name: dsh-serena
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Serena MCP integration - IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence (find/rename/edit symbols) for DSH agents, plus tool-usage hooks bridge
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 集成包：Serena MCP 集成 —— 为 DSH agents 提供 IDE 级的符号代码智能（查找/重命名/编辑符号），并桥接工具使用钩子。

plugins.name: dsh-bundle-memory
plugins.description: Workspace-local memory for DeepSeek Harness: an agent-managed ./memory/ store with an auto-generated MEMORY.md index, subdirectories created on demand, and four tools (save / recall / search / forget).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工作区本地记忆：由代理管理的 ./memory/ 存储，附带自动生成 MEMORY.md 索引，按需创建子目录，并提供四个工具（save / recall / search / forget）。

plugins.name: dsh-bundle-default-workspace
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the small miscellaneous stuff one default workspace — with an AGENTS.md top-level rule and a default_workspace agent tool.
plugins.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为默认工作空间统一管理零散小功能，含 AGENTS.md 顶层规则及 default_workspace 代理工具。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-reach
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Agent Reach skill - one-command internet reach for DSH agents (web, YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X, Reddit, RSS, Exa search) via the Agent Reach CLI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 套件：Agent Reach 技能——通过 Agent Reach CLI 为 DSH 智能体提供一键式互联网接入能力（支持网页、YouTube、GitHub、Twitter/X、Reddit、RSS 及 Exa 搜索）。

plugins.name: dsh-playwright

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-chat

plugins.name: dsh-workflow-studio

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Shell 的工作流工作室——通过 /workflow 启动工作流，并在实时看板中查看每个子代理的工作和结构。

plugins.zh: 鲸吟（dsh-notify-whale）：DSH 通知插件加固 fork。修复上游在 Node 22/24 上 HTTP 通道完全无法投递等 5 个 bug，新增等待审批/提问通知与事件级铃声。AI 主导修改。

plugins.zh: DSH液态玻璃皮肤插件：支持 DSH Web 与 Windows 桌面版，可调玻璃材质、流体背景与图片/视频壁纸，独立维护。

plugins.name: dsh-quorum
plugins.description: Mechanism-enforced discipline layer for DeepSeek Harness agent teams: role cards, quorum termination, evidence-gated reports, cost budgets.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent 团队的机制强制纪律层：角色卡、多数表决终止、证据审查报告、成本预算。

plugins.name: dsh-gh-pages-artifacts
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: let agents publish HTML pages and Markdown documents as shareable artifacts on GitHub Pages
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：允许 agent 发布 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档，作为可分享的资源托管至 GitHub Pages。

plugins.name: image-gen-mcp
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and Codex plugin: configurable, provider-agnostic image generation over MCP, plus a bundled image-generation skill. Exposes mcp__image_generation__image_generate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 Codex 插件：基于 MCP 的可配置、厂商无关的图像生成，附带捆绑的图像生成技能。暴露 mcp__image_generation__image_generate。

plugins.name: mcp-simple-image
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and MCP server: text-to-image through a StepFun-compatible /images/generations endpoint, with the configurable base URL, key and model. Exposes mcp__simple_image__simple_image.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 MCP 服务器：通过兼容 StepFun 的 /images/generations 端点实现文生图，支持可配置的 base URL、密钥和模型。暴露 mcp__simple_image__simple_image。

plugins.name: opencode-tokenrhythm-image-mcp
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and OpenCode MCP server: generate images with TokenRhythm (qwen-image-2.0, wan2.7-image) and save them to a directory you choose. Exposes mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件与 OpenCode MCP 服务器：使用 TokenRhythm（qwen-image-2.0、wan2.7-image）生成图像并保存至指定目录。暴露 mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image。

plugins.name: opencode-ppocr-mcp
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and OpenCode MCP server: local PP-OCRv6 Medium OCR (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) for images and multi-page PDFs. Exposes mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 OpenCode MCP 服务器：本地 PP-OCRv6 Medium OCR（基于 ONNX Runtime 的 PaddleOCR，CPU 模式），支持图片和多页 PDF。暴露 mcp__ppocr__ocr_image 和 mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf。

plugins.name: opencode-eyes-nvidia
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and OpenCode MCP server: describe an image with any of seven NVIDIA NIM vision models, rotating several API keys. Exposes mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 OpenCode MCP 服务器：使用七种 NVIDIA NIM 视觉模型之一描述图片，并轮换多个 API 密钥。暴露 mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image。

plugins.name: opencode-eyes
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and OpenCode MCP server: describe an image with StepFun step-3.7-flash, so a text-only model can see. Exposes mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 OpenCode MCP 服务器：使用 StepFun step-3.7-flash 描述图片，使纯文本模型也能“看见”。暴露 mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image。

plugins.name: plan-guardian-skill
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the plan-guardian skill — a mandatory 7-step plan with binary acceptance criteria, executed through worker subagents and validated by memoryless verifiers. The Codex original is kept.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：plan-guardian 技能——强制性的 7 步计划，带有二元验收标准，通过 worker 子智能体执行并由无状态验证器验证。保留 Codex 原版。

plugins.name: simple-plan
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the simple-plan skill — plan 2-7 steps, execute with worker subagents, verify every deliverable with a memoryless verifier, fix in at most three cycles. The Codex original is kept.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：simple-plan 技能——规划 2-7 个步骤，通过 worker 子智能体执行，由无状态验证器验证每一项交付物，最多三个循环完成修复。保留 Codex 原版。

plugins.name: math-rigor
plugins.description: Auditable mathematical proving for DeepSeek Harness: a local stdio MCP server (23 tools), a bundled workflow skill, and the /prove and /audit-proof commands. proven / refuted / inconclusive are never conflated, and unproven steps are reported, not hidden.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可审计数学证明：一个本地 stdio MCP 服务器（23 个工具）、捆绑的工作流技能，以及 /prove 和 /audit-proof 命令。证明/反驳/不确定三种状态严格区分，未证明的步骤会被报告而非隐藏。

plugins.name: dsh-comsol
plugins.description: DSH plugin: drive COMSOL Multiphysics end to end (steady + transient workflows) with a bundled MCP engine
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：通过内置 MCP 引擎驱动 COMSOL Multiphysics 全流程（稳态 + 瞬态工作流）。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-mcp-bridge
plugins.description: dsh 项目桥接插件：自动导入 .claude/.agents/.trae skills 并桥接 MCP 服务器（HTTP/SSE + stdio），GUI 开关控制、状态持久化
plugins.zh: dsh 项目桥接插件：自动导入 .claude/.agents/.trae skills 并桥接 MCP 服务器（HTTP/SSE + stdio），GUI 开关控制、状态持久化

plugins.name: dsh-warden
plugins.description: Adversary review gate for DeepSeek Harness: an independent small model reviews destructive tool calls before they run, and reports every verdict. · DSH 对抗式审查门：危险工具调用在执行前由一个独立小模型复核。
plugins.zh: Adversary review gate for DeepSeek Harness: an independent small model reviews destructive tool calls before they run, and reports every verdict. · DSH 对抗式审查门：危险工具调用在执行前由一个独立小模型复核。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-screenshot
plugins.description: 面向模型的「截图」工具插件（DeepSeek Harness，Windows 宿主）。  注册一个 screenshot 工具，让会话里的 AI 能真正「看见」并展示你的屏幕。
plugins.zh: 面向模型的「截图」工具插件（DeepSeek Harness，Windows 宿主）。  注册一个 screenshot 工具，让会话里的 AI 能真正「看见」并展示你的屏幕。

plugins.name: dsh-project-summary
plugins.description: Compact floating Git project summary for DeepSeek Harness: branch, changes, commits and GitHub PR. Follows DSH themes and conversation bounds.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 紧凑型浮动 Git 项目摘要：分支、变更、提交与 GitHub PR。遵循 DSH 主题与对话边界。

plugins.name: dsh-email-board
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 邮件看板插件：把 dsh-email 各账号的未读邮件汇总成右侧栏卡片列表 / Unread-mail board for DSH — per-account card list in the right sidebar.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 邮件看板插件：把 dsh-email 各账号的未读邮件汇总成右侧栏卡片列表 / Unread-mail board for DSH — per-account card list in the right sidebar.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-zquota
plugins.description: GLM Coding Plan quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account usage meters and one-click account switching
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GLM Coding Plan 配额面板：多账号用量统计与一键切换。

plugins.name: dsh-apb
plugins.description: 基于标准编码 Agent 的渐进式开发助手。ask/plan/build 三模式由宿主权限预设强制（ask/plan→只读、build→可写工作区），可 Alt+M 或 /apb 切换并随会话持久；遵循先讨论定方向、入口与文件规划、todo 占位、逐模块实现调试、走通后再分步重构的人类式小步开发纪律。
plugins.zh: 基于标准编码 Agent 的渐进式开发助手。ask/plan/build 三模式由宿主权限预设强制（ask/plan→只读、build→可写工作区），可 Alt+M 或 /apb 切换并随会话持久；遵循先讨论定方向、入口与文件规划、todo 占位、逐模块实现调试、走通后再分步重构的人类式小步开发纪律。

plugins.name: dsh-cad-preview
plugins.description: CAD 3D 模型预览 / CAD 3D model preview for the DSH sidebar: STEP/STP/IGES/BREP (OpenCascade WASM, parsed in a Web Worker) + STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY, with orbit camera, structural edges, wireframe and an axis gizmo. Works with dsh-better-sidebar or DSH's built-in document preview.
plugins.zh: CAD 3D 模型预览 / CAD 3D model preview for the DSH sidebar: STEP/STP/IGES/BREP (OpenCascade WASM, parsed in a Web Worker) + STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY, with orbit camera, structural edges, wireframe and an axis gizmo. Works with dsh-better-sidebar or DSH's built-in document preview.

plugins.name: dsh-obscura
plugins.description: Obscura settings-page plugin for DeepSeek Harness: starts and health-checks the obscura MCP server, resolves its binary from PATH or bin/, and keeps the mcp-obscura entry in your profile in sync.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Obscura 设置页插件：启动并健康检查 obscura MCP 服务器，从 PATH 或 bin/ 解析其二进制，并保持你配置文件中 mcp-obscura 条目同步。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-lite
plugins.description: DSH plugin: token usage statistics across all sessions as a settings page (zero-dep, no build)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：跨所有会话的 Token 用量统计设置页（零依赖，无需构建）

plugins.name: dsh-project-space
plugins.description: Workspace resource library for DeepSeek Harness: organize, preview and reuse references and deliverables.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区资源库：组织、预览并复用参考资料与交付物。

plugins.name: @octen.ai/dsh-octen
plugins.description: Octen web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness: web_search through Octen /search, web_fetch through Octen /extract.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Octen 网页搜索与抓取：通过 Octen /search 执行 web_search，通过 Octen /extract 执行 web_fetch。

plugins.name: dsh-decision-router
plugins.description: Decision-model-powered routing for DeepSeek Harness, with local inference and opt-in cloud decisions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的决策模型路由：支持本地推理和可选云端决策。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-push
plugins.description: Push DeepSeek Harness agent notifications to your phone and watch via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Telegram or a webhook.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通知推送到手机，通过 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Telegram 或 webhook 接收。

plugins.name: dsh-undo
plugins.description: Turn-level file undo for DeepSeek Harness: every write and edit is snapshotted before it lands, and the model can call the undo tool to roll back all files a conversation turn changed.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的回合级文件撤销功能：每次写入和编辑都会在生效前创建快照，模型可调用撤销工具回滚所有在当前对话回合中变更的文件。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-billing
plugins.description: Billing widget plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: current-session cost and API balance at the sidebar foot (dsh-plugin)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 计费组件插件：在侧边栏底部显示当前会话费用和 API 余额 (dsh-plugin)。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-config
plugins.description: 为解决dsh导入订阅后配置模型的思考强度等问题而创建的插件
plugins.zh: 为解决dsh导入订阅后配置模型的思考强度等问题而创建的插件

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-agnes-image

plugins.name: dsh-auto-workspace

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 无项目式聊天：新建的无项目聊天拥有独立的本地工作目录，并保留 DSH 原生的新建聊天界面。

plugins.name: dsh-rss-reader
plugins.description: 内嵌在 DSH 里的 RSS / Atom 阅读器
plugins.zh: 内嵌在 DSH 里的 RSS / Atom 阅读器

plugins.name: dsh-model-aliases
plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化模型别名：将提供商、模型与推理等级绑定为易记名称，并通过输入框旁的单一选择器快速切换。
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化模型别名：将提供商、模型与推理等级绑定为易记名称，并通过输入框旁的单一选择器快速切换。

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: Bring Qoder CN desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: decrypt the OSCrypt local sign-in, sign requests with the COSY scheme, and register a Qoder model group. No OAuth interaction needed.
plugins.zh: 将 Qoder CN 桌面应用模型引入 DeepSeek Harness：解密 OSCrypt 本地登录，使用 COSY 方案签名请求，并注册 Qoder 模型组。无需 OAuth 交互。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-everything
plugins.description: DSH plugin: instant file search via the Everything HTTP API
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：通过 Everything HTTP API 即时搜索文件

plugins.name: dsh-tool-websearch
plugins.description: DSH metasearch plugin: 200+ engines, no API key
plugins.zh: DSH 元搜索插件：覆盖 200+ 搜索引擎，无需 API 密钥。

plugins.name: @leolee9086/dsh-fetch-router
plugins.description: Route and rewrite the harness's outbound HTTP requests by host and path, with a native right-sidebar monitor.
plugins.zh: 按主机和路径路由及重写 harness 出站 HTTP 请求，并附带原生右侧边栏监控。

plugins.name: dsh-bazaar

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件集市，支持 GitHub 发现与官方插件安装

plugins.name: dsh-session-folders
plugins.description: 每个 DSH 会话一个时间戳产物目录：会话留在原工作区，插件注入「产物目录」规则；可选硬隔离模式。 Per-conversation output directories for DeepSeek Harness sessions.
plugins.zh: 每个 DSH 会话一个时间戳产物目录：会话留在原工作区，插件注入「产物目录」规则；可选硬隔离模式。 Per-conversation output directories for DeepSeek Harness sessions.

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Firecrawl 搜索引擎提供商及多账户设置。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：每次助手回复结束时播放「来了，老弟」完成提示音（先显示文本，回复完毕再响）。A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a greeting sound when every assistant reply finishes — text first, sound last.

plugins.name: dsh-aiagent-taskboard

plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 极简实时任务看板：列出 Claude Code / Codex / DSH / Open Design 当前正在做什么——列表 + 泳道时间线。

plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 BharatCode 和 OpenAI 兼容提供商，同时搭配 ChatGPT 和 GitHub Copilot 订阅。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器一键提示词增强：模型选择器旁边的芯片利用当前会话模型将草稿重写为结构化提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-cli-mode
plugins.description: Command-line mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a composer line starting with ！ or ! runs as a real command in the session workspace instead of being sent to the model.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的命令行模式：以 ！或 ! 开头的 Composer 行将作为真实命令在会话工作区执行，而非发送至模型。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-transcribe
plugins.description: dsh 插件：本地语音/视频转写——QQ/微信那种 SILK 语音先解码，再用 SenseVoice 转成文字，全程不花 API 钱（约 0.1 秒/条） · Local speech-to-text for dsh: SILK decoding + SenseVoice (sherpa-onnx int8), no API cost, ~0.1 s per clip.
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：本地语音/视频转写——QQ/微信那种 SILK 语音先解码，再用 SenseVoice 转成文字，全程不花 API 钱（约 0.1 秒/条） · Local speech-to-text for dsh: SILK decoding + SenseVoice (sherpa-onnx int8), no API cost, ~0.1 s per clip.

plugins.name: dsh-bot
plugins.description: Resident agent entity for DeepSeek Harness: bots that live outside any session, with file-based memory you can open and edit, a task queue, an approval gate, and an optional background executor. Ships no platform integrations.好多bug啊，让我再修修吧。感兴趣的可以star一下
plugins.zh: Resident agent entity for DeepSeek Harness: bots that live outside any session, with file-based memory you can open and edit, a task queue, an approval gate, and an optional background executor. Ships no platform integrations.好多bug啊，让我再修修吧。感兴趣的可以star一下

plugins.name: dsh-t3-new-session-screen
plugins.description: T3 Code's New Session screen for DeepSeek Harness: the "What should we build in <project>?" headline with an inline project dropdown, a reasoning-effort picker, and a git branch picker.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的新会话界面：带有内嵌项目下拉菜单、推理力度选择器和 git 分支选择器的「我们要在 <project> 中构建什么？」标题

plugins.name: dsh-standalone-settings
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的设置入口从账号按钮的二级菜单里独立出来：在侧边栏底部 账号按钮的右端固定一个独立的设置按钮。
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的设置入口从账号按钮的二级菜单里独立出来：在侧边栏底部 账号按钮的右端固定一个独立的设置按钮。

plugins.name: galvanize-dsh
plugins.description: Triggers inside your DSH agent: wake a fresh DeepSeek Harness session when files, mail, webhooks, or git events happen. Native Cordis bundle, heartbeat-proved install.
plugins.zh: DSH 代理内部触发器：当文件、邮件、Webhook 或 Git 事件发生时唤醒新的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。原生 Cordis 打包，心跳验证安装。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search
plugins.description: dsh-web-search — Multi-provider web search for DeepSeek Harness: routes the native web_search tool through a configurable provider fallback chain (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Firecrawl/Jina/Kagi/SearXNG/DuckDuckGo), replacing the built-in deepseek-official backend, with a settings page for key management and ordering. Approach adapted from OMP.
plugins.zh: dsh-web-search —— DeepSeek Harness 多提供商网页搜索：将原生 web_search 工具路由至可配置的提供商故障转移链（Tavily/Brave/Exa/Firecrawl/Jina/Kagi/SearXNG/DuckDuckGo），替换内置 deepseek-official 后端，并提供用于密钥管理与排序的设置页面。方案借鉴自 OMP。

plugins.name: dsh-quick-reload
plugins.description: A one-click page refresh for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: it reboots the page against the freshly published module graph so a hot-injected client plugin appears immediately, purging the rebuildable caches first.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 一键刷新：重启页面以加载最新发布的模块图，使热注入的客户端插件立即生效，并先清空可重建缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-aionui-layout
plugins.description: AionUi-style two-column right sidebar for the DSH Web GUI, seeded on top of dsh-better-sidebar (preview + files/changes), no build step
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 AionUi 风格两列右侧边栏，基于 dsh-better-sidebar 构建（预览 + 文件/变更），无需构建步骤

plugins.name: dsh-houhuiyao
plugins.description: DSH Web「后悔药」插件：最后一条回答上的重新生成 / 编辑提问 / 删除这轮 / 版本翻页器（判据读全量日志，不受客户端 50 条窗口裁剪影响）
plugins.zh: DSH Web「后悔药」插件：最后一条回答上的重新生成 / 编辑提问 / 删除这轮 / 版本翻页器（判据读全量日志，不受客户端 50 条窗口裁剪影响）

plugins.name: dsh-paper-reader
plugins.description: Local paper reading for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar reader panel plus paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan tools, with a from-scratch pure-Node PDF text extractor (no third-party deps, no network).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地论文阅读：侧边栏阅读面板，附带 paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan 工具；内置从零开始的纯 Node.js PDF 文本提取器（无第三方依赖，无网络请求）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-calendar-clock
plugins.description: Calendar clock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar: a live clock, an analog dial, and a month calendar. (dsh-plugin)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 侧边栏日历时钟插件：实时时钟、模拟表盘和月份日历。（dsh-plugin）

plugins.zh: 功能齐全的 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）提供者插件。 A full-featured CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) provider plugin.

plugins.name: clear-session-history
plugins.description: dsh plugin: clear session history from disk (workspace/all/session) with scoped, confirmed deletes
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：从磁盘清除会话历史（工作区/全部/单个会话），支持作用域限定与确认后删除

plugins.name: dsh-scratchpad
plugins.description: Scratch pad: one shared floating text surface in the middle of the screen, opened by other plugins through the client service scratchpad.
plugins.zh: 便签：屏幕中央的一个共享浮动文本表面，由其他插件通过客户端服务便签功能打开。

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Ollama Cloud remaining quota in Settings, with an in-page API key editor. · DSH 插件：设置页显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度并支持填写 API Key。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Ollama Cloud remaining quota in Settings, with an in-page API key editor. · DSH 插件：设置页显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度并支持填写 API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-paperdesk
plugins.description: DSH paper workbench: arXiv search → local library (metadata/PDF/full text) → L1/L2/L3 three-layer reading notes. Host + browser halves in one package, no build step.
plugins.zh: DSH 论文工作台：arXiv 搜索 → 本地图书馆（元数据/PDF/全文）→ L1/L2/L3 三层阅读笔记。Host + Browser 两半合一，无需构建步骤。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-free
plugins.description: 星桥模式：OpenCode 免费模型路线的前缀稳定与载荷控制 Agent 预设（配套 dsh-opencode-xdbridge）
plugins.zh: 星桥模式：OpenCode 免费模型路线的前缀稳定与载荷控制 Agent 预设（配套 dsh-opencode-xdbridge）

plugins.name: dsh-envelope-highlight
plugins.description: Restore syntax highlighting of read/write tool envelopes inside run_code (PTC / Code Mode) result cards
plugins.zh: 恢复 run_code (PTC / 代码模式) 结果卡片中 read/write 工具信封的语法高亮

plugins.name: dsh-token-rush
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 悬浮仪表：实时 token 消耗 / 估算金额 / 账户余额，高峰时段自动变橙红色。A floating token / cost / balance HUD that turns orange-red during DeepSeek rush hours.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 悬浮仪表：实时 token 消耗 / 估算金额 / 账户余额，高峰时段自动变橙红色。A floating token / cost / balance HUD that turns orange-red during DeepSeek rush hours.

plugins.name: dsh-text-inject
plugins.description: dsh 插件：在官方设置页把文字注入系统提示词 / 会话上下文，独立文件存储，热加载 + 历史备份 · Inject text into the DSH system prompt or session context from a Settings page
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：在官方设置页把文字注入系统提示词 / 会话上下文，独立文件存储，热加载 + 历史备份 · Inject text into the DSH system prompt or session context from a Settings page

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Security-bounded Agent Skill management and GitHub marketplace plugin for DeepSeek Harness and DSH Desktop
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop 的安全受限智能体技能管理与 GitHub 市场插件

plugins.zh: DSH 会话 Bark 通知插件：会话头部按钮切换「会通知」状态（持久化），轮次停止时经 Bark 推送到手机；设置页配 server/key 并提供 ping→push→register 三步连通测试

plugins.description: 乔木 Home：让 Harness 成为一天的起点。会话搜索、今日重点、待办、记录与专注计时。
plugins.zh: 乔木 Home：让 Harness 成为一天的起点。会话搜索、今日重点、待办、记录与专注计时。

plugins.name: dsh-sync
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: sync sessions and profile configuration across machines with rclone bisync, with a configurable sync scope and guided WebDAV setup.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rclone bisync 在多台机器间同步会话与配置文件，支持可配置的同步范围及引导式 WebDAV 设置。

plugins.name: dsh-send-debounce

plugins.name: @wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch

plugins.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的 WebSearchProvider（适用于 DeepSeek Harness dsh）：注册 AnySearch 的 /v1/search 接口，从插件页面配置中显式切换官方 DeepSeek 搜索端点与 AnySearch；兼容 dsh v0.1.5-alpha.1 及以上版本。

plugins.name: dsh-billing
plugins.description: DSH plugin: prices tokens with the official model price table, shows the running cost beside the composer context meter, and blocks a turn once spend passes the ceiling you set.
plugins.zh: DSH插件：依据官方模型价格表计算令牌成本，在编辑器上下文度量旁显示实时费用，并在消费超过你设定的上限时阻止下一轮生成。

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete

plugins.name: dsh-session-eraser

plugins.zh: 从 DSH 侧边栏删除会话。DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件。

plugins.description: Pomodoro focus clock plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: ambient timer under the composer, daily rounds, local preferences
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的番茄钟专注时钟插件：作曲家下方的环境计时器、每日轮次、本地偏好设置

plugins.description: 「日语翻译」模式

plugins.zh: 对账 DSH 任务账本与 OS 进程树，定位归属、检测泄漏并安全治理｜Reconcile DSH task ledgers with OS process trees for attribution, leak detection, and safe governance.

plugins.name: dsh-queue-merge
plugins.description: Queue Consolidation for DeepSeek Harness: merge queued follow-up messages into one consolidated formal prompt for the next turn instead of piecemeal one-message-per-turn rework.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 队列整合：将待处理的后续消息合并为一个整合的形式提示，用于下一轮交互，避免逐条消息碎片化处理。

plugins.name: dsh-code-reuse-firewall
plugins.description: Pre-write reuse firewall for DeepSeek Harness: before the agent writes a new helper/service, surface the existing implementations that already cover that intent. Deterministic retrieval (no LLM) via the Auto_code_audit capability channel.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的预写复用防火墙：在 agent 编写新的 helper/service 之前，通过 Auto_code_audit 能力通道（确定性检索，无需 LLM）展示已覆盖该意图的现有实现。

plugins.name: deep-browser

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，使用 synthetic.new 网页搜索替代内置的 Deepseek 网页搜索

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在工具调用层强制「先委派给其他模型」——未派发的会话无法执行 pwsh/write/edit。⚠️ 本插件会拦截工具调用（这是设计目标）；含举证式放行、行为账本与一键停用开关。

plugins.name: dsh-ollama

plugins.name: dsh-wo-tmux

plugins.zh: Workspace Overview tmux 标签页：实时/冻结/冷启动会话状态，通过 tmux-fridge 一键连接终端，支持冻结/快照/恢复，以及工作区与会话链接。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-overview
plugins.description: Workspace overview: a Workspace Overview tab beside Chat with a subtab facade for other plugins, and a GitHub pill in the session header when the workspace has a github.com repository.
plugins.zh: 工作区概览：在聊天旁新增工作区概览标签页，为其他插件提供子标签页外观；当工作区包含 GitHub 仓库时，会话头部显示 GitHub 徽标。

plugins.zh: DSH 的提示词编写管理器：实时统计每个系统提示词区块，支持屏蔽和替换、自定义系统提示词，并在聊天编写器中内置角色库选择器

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-history

plugins.zh: 用于 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的 Agnes AI 图像/视频生成工具 (agnes_image / agnes_video)。内置跨进程 RPM 速率限制、429 退避策略和本地 ffmpeg GIF 转换功能。

plugins.name: dsh-pen
plugins.description: Enable Deepseek Harness to paint (literally).
plugins.zh: 让 Deepseek Harness 具备绘画（字面意义）能力。

plugins.name: dsh-session-folders

plugins.zh: 从 GitHub 主题 dsh-plugin 发现和安装 DSH 插件——支持浏览、阅读 README（可选中文翻译）及一键安装。

plugins.name: dsh-deep-purge
plugins.description: 彻底删除 DSH 会话：日志 + 投影缓存 + 工作区记账 + 引用计数式附件回收 | Thorough session purge for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话：日志 + 投影缓存 + 工作区记账 + 引用计数式附件回收 | Thorough session purge for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: @artenx/dshb
plugins.description: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 的文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作路由至本地、SSH 及 Docker 执行节点，包含节点注册表、身份验证门控、移动端感知的管理 UI 以及每工作区的自定义项目指令。

plugins.name: dsh-model-tester

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在「模型」设置页一键测试模型可用性（可用性 / TPS / 首 token / 耗时）。 | DSH plugin: one-click model availability testing (available / TPS / first token / elapsed) in the Models settings page.

plugins.name: dsh-webhook-notifier
plugins.description: DSH 插件：AI 回合完成、权限申请、提问、出错、开始运行等场景发生时，向 Webhook 发送自定义 HTTP 通知（GET/POST、预设字段或自定义文本、发送日志）。 | DSH plugin: send custom HTTP webhook notifications on DSH events (turn completed, permission request, question, error, run started) - GET/POST, preset fields or custom text, send log.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：AI 回合完成、权限申请、提问、出错、开始运行等场景发生时，向 Webhook 发送自定义 HTTP 通知（GET/POST、预设字段或自定义文本、发送日志）。 | DSH plugin: send custom HTTP webhook notifications on DSH events (turn completed, permission request, question, error, run started) - GET/POST, preset fields or custom text, send log.

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：按 DeepSeek 峰谷分时计价，在高峰时段给 token 花销踩刹车（拦大任务 / 压缩输出上限 / 让模型少说废话），并提供一键放行口令

plugins.name: dsh-doc-review

plugins.name: dsh-echocat-prettier

plugins.name: dsh-stealth-reader
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面里伪装成日志流读小说：导入 txt/epub，只覆盖右侧消息区，鼠标一动即回到工作界面。
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面里伪装成日志流读小说：导入 txt/epub，只覆盖右侧消息区，鼠标一动即回到工作界面。

plugins.name: dsh-index-tap-bridge
plugins.description: Make tapIndex-based DSH plugins work in the official DeepSeek Harness desktop shell
plugins.zh: 使基于 tapIndex 的 DSH 插件在官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端工作

plugins.name: dsh-mv-session
plugins.description: A plug-in for Deepseek Harness that easy to move/rename session from old workspace to new workspace.
plugins.zh: Deepseek Harness 插件，便于将旧工作区中的会话移动或重命名到新工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-relay
plugins.description: DSH 外联通知中枢：生命周期事件经去重/免打扰/摘要合批后路由到 Bark/Server酱/Telegram/企业微信/飞书/ntfy/webhook。零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-soul-engine
plugins.description: 可审计的明文 Markdown 记忆账本插件（DSH / DeepSeek Harness）：14 个 soul_* 工具 + 轮首账本注入 + 零 token 自维护 + 心跳唤醒
plugins.zh: 可审计的明文 Markdown 记忆账本插件（DSH / DeepSeek Harness）：14 个 soul_* 工具 + 轮首账本注入 + 零 token 自维护 + 心跳唤醒

plugins.name: dsh-context-window
plugins.description: DSH 插件：复刻 Codex 最新上下文窗口管理 — token 预算提示 / 模型可调用的 new_context / 交接式换窗替代摘要压缩 | DSH plugin reimplementing Codex's context window management: token-budget notice, model-facing new_context, handoff window reset instead of summary compaction
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：复刻 Codex 最新上下文窗口管理 — token 预算提示 / 模型可调用的 new_context / 交接式换窗替代摘要压缩 | DSH plugin reimplementing Codex's context window management: token-budget notice, model-facing new_context, handoff window reset instead of summary compaction

plugins.name: dsh-api-balance
plugins.description: DSH 桌面插件：在桌面角落常驻一个置顶小窗，实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本次开机消耗的 token。七套配色、可用自己的图片当背景、× 收进托盘。
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：在桌面角落常驻一个置顶小窗，实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本次开机消耗的 token。七套配色、可用自己的图片当背景、× 收进托盘。

plugins.name: @walkerxie/dsh-plugin-quote
plugins.description: Select text in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation and append it to the composer as a markdown blockquote.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话中选中文本，并将其作为 Markdown 引用块追加到 composer 中。

plugins.name: dsh-session-topics
plugins.description: Sidebar topic grouping plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - client-only, zero host-service dependency, with offline smoke tests.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 侧边栏话题分组插件——纯客户端、零主机服务依赖，含离线冒烟测试。

plugins.name: dsh-settings-beautify
plugins.description: One design language for the DSH settings surface: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
plugins.zh: DSH 设置界面统一设计语言：在涵盖各插件页面的所有设置页中，实现统一的排版、卡片、控件、焦点样式和动效。

plugins.name: dsh-plannotator
plugins.description: Review a file, a folder or a web page in the Plannotator browser UI from DeepSeek Harness, and get the annotations back as a message.
plugins.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中，于Plannotator浏览器界面内审查文件、文件夹或网页，并将标注内容作为消息返回。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-recall
plugins.description: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool keeping a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message, plus session_search over earlier chats behind an approval prompt.
plugins.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 DSH 持久化记忆：一个维护用户画像与模型自身笔记的记忆工具，作为日志上下文消息送达每次聊天，并在确认提示后提供对历史聊天的 session_search 搜索能力。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-model-filter
plugins.description: A DSH plugin that adds a search / filter box to the model selection menu in the DSH chat composer.
plugins.zh: 一款 DSH 插件，为 DSH 聊天编辑器的模型选择菜单添加搜索/过滤框。

plugins.name: dsh-tts-live
plugins.description: Live sentence-level TTS for DeepSeek Harness with early speech, ordered streaming, barge-in cancellation, and custom WAV provider fixes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时句子级 TTS：支持提前播放、有序流式传输、点击取消（barge-in），并修复自定义 WAV 提供程序。

plugins.name: @zseven-w/dsh-computer
plugins.description: A headless-first macOS Computer Use driver for DeepSeek Harness with AX-first observations, window-bound multimodal evidence, host-owned approval, and evidence-backed action receipts
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的无头优先 macOS Computer Use 驱动：基于 AX 优先的观察、窗口绑定的多模态证据、主机拥有的审批以及基于证据的行动回执。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily-resilient-search
plugins.description: Pesquisa web Tavily para o DeepSeek Harness (plugin Cordis) com rotação atómica e resiliente de um agrupamento de chaves de API — rate limit, cota mensal e revogação sem interromper o agent loop.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tavily 网络搜索插件（Cordis 插件），具备原子性且 resilent 的 API 密钥池轮换机制 —— 速率限制、月度配额和撤销均不会中断 agent 循环。

plugins.name: dsh-power-switch
plugins.description: 一个Deepseek Harness 的进程结束插件，在左下角会有关闭按钮，本插件还同时有页面切换，在应用模式时关闭进程会自动关闭当前页面，标签页模式则不行
plugins.zh: 一个Deepseek Harness 的进程结束插件，在左下角会有关闭按钮，本插件还同时有页面切换，在应用模式时关闭进程会自动关闭当前页面，标签页模式则不行

plugins.name: dsh-model-proxy
plugins.description: DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：按模型配置代理路由（http/https/socks5）及设置界面——例如 opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor 需要代理，而同级模型直连

plugins.name: @wjj-8283/dsh-temp-workspace
plugins.description: DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Adds a small icon beside the sidebar's "Add workspace" button
plugins.zh: DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Adds a small icon beside the sidebar's "Add workspace" button

plugins.name: dsh-web-searxng
plugins.description: Self-hosted SearXNG search backend for DSH — settings card, one-click connectivity tests, and a self-ranking community instance picker. No third-party search API needed.
plugins.zh: DSH 的自托管 SearXNG 搜索后端 —— 设置卡片、一键连通性测试以及社区自排名实例选择器。无需第三方搜索 API。

plugins.name: dsh-zh-meow
plugins.description: dsh插件 喵体中文 ~ 大家一起喵起来喵~
plugins.zh: dsh插件 喵体中文 ~ 大家一起喵起来喵~

plugins.name: @kasenri/dsh-orbit
plugins.description: 让 AI 项目可以在无人监管下持续推进。Orbit 会自动规划任务、分工执行、逐步检查并继续完成后续工作；不同环节可以使用不同模型，让低成本模型承担执行任务、强模型负责规划和审核，从而降低整体 AI 使用成本。Watchdog 还会监控运行异常，在任务卡死或中断时协助恢复。
plugins.zh: 让 AI 项目可以在无人监管下持续推进。Orbit 会自动规划任务、分工执行、逐步检查并继续完成后续工作；不同环节可以使用不同模型，让低成本模型承担执行任务、强模型负责规划和审核，从而降低整体 AI 使用成本。Watchdog 还会监控运行异常，在任务卡死或中断时协助恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-orbit
plugins.description: Installable GitHub release mirror for @kasenri/dsh-orbit. Canonical source: KasenRi/dsh-orbit-browser-plugins.
plugins.zh: @kasenri/dsh-orbit 的可安装 GitHub 发布镜像。 canonical 源：KasenRi/dsh-orbit-browser-plugins。

plugins.name: dsh-command-queue
plugins.description: DSH 插件：让 /compact 等斜杠命令在 agent 忙碌时进入命令队列，空闲后自动执行 | Queue slash commands until the agent is idle
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：让 /compact 等斜杠命令在 agent 忙碌时进入命令队列，空闲后自动执行 | Queue slash commands until the agent is idle

plugins.name: dsh-session-rescue
plugins.description: Session-stall watchdog for DeepSeek Harness: releases a hung turn in place instead of restarting the app.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话卡顿看门狗：原地释放挂起的轮次，而非重启应用。

plugins.name: dsh-router-sci
plugins.description: 科研计算 Agent 预设 — 核工程粉体/多相流仿真（LAMMPS + Fluent DPM + LaTeX）的 dsh agent preset
plugins.zh: 科研计算 Agent 预设 — 核工程粉体/多相流仿真（LAMMPS + Fluent DPM + LaTeX）的 dsh agent preset

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-screenshot-ask
plugins.description: DSH 截图提问插件：原生框选截图直接进输入框，全程不落盘（DeepSeek Harness plugin, Windows）
plugins.zh: DSH 截图提问插件：原生框选截图直接进输入框，全程不落盘（DeepSeek Harness plugin, Windows）

plugins.name: dsh-reverse-proxy-xc
plugins.description: DSH LAN reverse proxy plugin for accessing Web GUI from mobile devices
plugins.zh: DSH LAN 反向代理插件，支持从移动设备访问 Web GUI。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage-xc
plugins.description: DSH token usage statistics plugin with daily/7-day trends and cache hit rate
plugins.zh: DSH Token 使用统计插件，支持每日/7天趋势及缓存命中率

plugins.name: dsh-chat-tune
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: tune chat font, width, line height, and paragraph spacing
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：调节聊天字体、宽度、行高和段落间距

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-usage-stats
plugins.description: Whole-corpus token usage statistics for DSH: daily and cumulative tokens, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown, and a year-long activity heatmap.
plugins.zh: DSH 全语料库 token 使用统计：每日和累计 token 数、缓存命中率、按模型分类明细，以及长达一年的活动热力图。

plugins.name: dsh-ask-notify
plugins.description: DSH web GUI plugin: a bottom-right reminder card when the agent is blocked waiting for your answer, plus a desktop notification and a flashing tab title when you are on another tab.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：当智能体阻塞等待你的回复时，右下角显示提醒卡片；切换至其他标签页时触发桌面通知并让标签页标题闪烁

plugins.name: dsh-session-import
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 会话导入与校验插件 | Import and verify DSH session exports with validation, state sync, rollback protection, and an in-app UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话导入与校验插件 | Import and verify DSH session exports with validation, state sync, rollback protection, and an in-app UI.

plugins.name: dsh-cursor-theme

plugins.zh: Per-state mouse cursor theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 18 original preset themes covering 14 UI states, ZIP image pack import/export, hotspot/size editing, and one-click system-level cursor apply on Windows (registry + SPI_SETCURSORS) with an experimental macOS overlay. 为 DSH 自定义鼠标各种状态的图案，覆盖 14 种 UI 状态。

plugins.description: DSH 归档会话管理插件，支持查看归档列表、原位恢复与跨区迁移，Web 侧边栏一键管理
plugins.zh: DSH 归档会话管理插件，支持查看归档列表、原位恢复与跨区迁移，Web 侧边栏一键管理

plugins.name: dsh-knowcode

plugins.name: dsh-whale-particles-bg

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI 的动态鲸鱼粒子背景——从碎片中组装、空闲时呼吸，并可被指针推动。

plugins.name: @0x427567/dsh-tavily
plugins.description: Tavily-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web): keyless-first credentials, a cooldown after the keyless tier refuses, and a user-visible notice when it falls back to the key.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-data-mask

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 剪贴板数据脱敏插件：敏感值在到达编辑器前即被屏蔽

plugins.name: dsh-jev-lens
plugins.description: Jev quality bench for DeepSeek Harness: shadow-accounted dangerous-command judging, injection screening, canary A/B drills, optional gate mode.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Jev 质量基准：影子账户危险命令评判、注入筛选、金标准 A/B 演练、可选门控模式。

plugins.name: dsh-course-subtitles

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-layout
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。

plugins.name: dsh-wx-preview

plugins.zh: DSH 便携插件，用于原生微信小程序的发现、本地预览、调试、源码映射及侧边栏检查。

plugins.zh: Codex 风格的 DSH 右侧边栏浏览器预览、元素标注、上下文注释及调试工具。

plugins.name: dsh-upstream-model-audit
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: show the model name the upstream actually returned, under every assistant step
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：在每个助手步骤下方显示上游实际返回的模型名称。

plugins.name: dsh-model-caps
plugins.description: Fill blank context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers. | 给自定义供应商补上空白的上下文、输出上限、思考等级与线协议 compat。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vajraclaw
plugins.description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
plugins.zh: DSH 本地工具调用故障安全：在执行前拦截高风险 shell 模式和凭证文件读取，附带按会话哈希链接的 JSONL 审计日志，并提供可选的外部 Gateway 用于集中策略管理。

plugins.name: dsh-shutdown
plugins.description: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程
plugins.zh: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程

plugins.name: trading-agent
plugins.description: trading agent for dsh
plugins.zh: dsh 的交易代理

plugins.name: dsh-typesafe-ask
plugins.description: Ask TypeSafe (Jev) for structured decisions from inside DeepSeek Harness: typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out.
plugins.zh: 向 TypeSafe (Jev) 提问：在 DeepSeek Harness 内获取结构化决策，输入类型化问题，输出校准后的概率。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-notes
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-offpeak-inbox
plugins.description: Off-peak inbox for DeepSeek Harness: capture thoughts and todos whenever they occur, and the host launches each one as a real session only while the DeepSeek API bills at its off-peak rate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 低谷时段收件箱：随时记录想法与待办事项，主机仅在 DeepSeek API 按低谷费率计费时启动真实会话处理这些内容。

plugins.name: dsh-tools
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。

plugins.name: dsh-task-console
plugins.description: DSH client plugin: flip the page over to a glass task console — live jobs, subagents, session and workspace cards, an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into its own controls, embedded web apps, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：翻转到毛玻璃任务控制台——实时任务、子智能体、会话与工作区卡片、无限画布可将卡片展开为独立控件、嵌入式 Web 应用，以及可编辑画布的对话框。

plugins.name: dsh-global-rules
plugins.description: Global AGENTS-style rules as many independent markdown files, with a settings GUI — fills the gap left by DeepSeek Harness's single hard-coded global AGENTS.md.
plugins.zh: 全局 AGENTS 风格规则，以多个独立 markdown 文件形式存在，配有设置 GUI——弥补 DeepSeek Harness 仅支持单个硬编码全局 AGENTS.md 的不足。

plugins.name: dsh-ark-plans
plugins.description: Volcengine Ark Agent Plan and Coding Plan model routes for DeepSeek Harness, with a session-header quota pill
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的火山引擎 Ark Agent Plan 和 Coding Plan 模型路由，支持会话头部的配额显示。

plugins.name: dsh-qianyuan
plugins.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server — shared pitfall/result records and capability lookup for agents.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 QianYuan MCP 服务器——共享陷阱/结果记录及代理的能力查找。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-path-completion
plugins.description: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）
plugins.zh: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）

plugins.name: dsh-force-motion
plugins.description: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效
plugins.zh: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for OpenCode Go (zen-go route)
plugins.zh: OpenCode Go (zen-go 路由) 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM 提供商插件

plugins.name: dsh-output-style
plugins.description: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-assist
plugins.description: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容
plugins.zh: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容

plugins.name: dsh-model-latency-test
plugins.description: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.

plugins.name: dsh-top-drag
plugins.description: DSH Desktop (Windows): keeps the top of the window draggable and clickable at the same time.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop (Windows)：保持窗口顶部同时可拖拽和点击。

plugins.name: dsh-backup
plugins.description: 由于 dsh 的自定义范围太大，很难通过一个插件或者程序来完美备份自己的配置，所以我觉得可以通过 ai 来分析哪些配置需要备份、可以备份，以及在新的环境中如何恢复。有了这个 skills 导出的配置文件，任意 agent 都可以帮助恢复 dsh 的配置。
plugins.zh: 由于 dsh 的自定义范围太大，很难通过一个插件或者程序来完美备份自己的配置，所以我觉得可以通过 ai 来分析哪些配置需要备份、可以备份，以及在新的环境中如何恢复。有了这个 skills 导出的配置文件，任意 agent 都可以帮助恢复 dsh 的配置。

plugins.name: dsh-md-reader
plugins.description: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader
plugins.zh: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader

plugins.name: dsh-growth
plugins.description: dsh-growth 是一个本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于把 Markdown、CSV 和 JSONL 中的增长资料与业务数据，转化为可解释的增长诊断、落地方案和执行 SOP。 dsh-growth is a local-first DeepSeek Harness bundle for evidence-backed user growth and customer acquisition analysis, actionable plans and execution SOPs.
plugins.zh: dsh-growth 是一个本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于把 Markdown、CSV 和 JSONL 中的增长资料与业务数据，转化为可解释的增长诊断、落地方案和执行 SOP。 dsh-growth is a local-first DeepSeek Harness bundle for evidence-backed user growth and customer acquisition analysis, actionable plans and execution SOPs.

plugins.name: dsh-business

plugins.zh: 商业策略与商业化插件，覆盖商业模式、定价与渠道价盘、盈利能力、电梯 Pitch 和商业计划。 Evidence-backed business strategy and commercialization tools for business models, pricing architecture, channel economics, profitability, elevator pitches and business plans.

plugins.name: dsh-product
plugins.description: dsh-product 是一个“互联网资讯查询 + 本地项目上下文”的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于把已经确认的产品机会转化为可验证、可交付、可迭代的产品。 dsh-product is a web-aware DeepSeek Harness plugin that combines public internet research with local product context to turn a validated opportunity handoff into a shippable, observable and iterated product.

plugins.zh: 从设置中显示或隐藏 DSH 侧边栏中的工作区：被隐藏的将沉底，其会话将被归档而非混入未分组列表。仅影响本地配置，可逆，不会删除任何内容。

plugins.name: dsh-work-done-bell
plugins.description: DSH plugin: ring a Windows system sound when a DeepSeek Harness session is truly done
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：当 DeepSeek Harness 会话真正结束时播放 Windows 系统提示音

plugins.name: dsh-x-opencode-session
plugins.description: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，为 LLM provider 请求注入动态/随机的 HTTP 请求头。DSH 的 pi-ai provider 只支持静态 headers 字符串，无法表达动态值；本插件通过包装 globalThis.fetch，按 urlPatterns 匹配请求并注入 ${uuid} 等模板值（每个 DSH 进程铸造唯一且在进程内稳定的会话 id），解决 opencode-go 网关对 x-opencode-session 头的要求（缺失会返回 400 Model is unavailable）。零默认、卸载安全、日志自动脱敏凭据。

plugins.description: DSH bundle: ensure/rotate the DeepSeek Harness web server (detached via WMI) — load to start it
plugins.zh: DSH 捆绑包：确保/轮换 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务器（通过 WMI 分离进程）——加载以启动服务器

plugins.name: dsh-sidechat
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Codex-style split-screen side chat with model switching and compact history navigation.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，添加 Codex 风格的分屏侧边聊天，支持模型切换与紧凑历史记录导航。

plugins.name: dsh-repo-analyzer
plugins.description: Local repository intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: stack detection, dependency maps, and module-reference analysis. No extra services — everything runs on your filesystem.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地仓库智能分析：堆栈检测、依赖地图与模块引用分析。无需额外服务，全部在文件系统本地运行。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor-windows
plugins.description: Windows environment diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Windows 环境诊断工具

plugins.name: dsh-qwen-multimodal
plugins.description: DSH bundle: Qwen multimodal bridge — vision (qwen3-vl), speech-to-text (qwen3-asr), text-to-image (qwen-image), for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DSH bundle：Qwen 多模态桥接——视觉（qwen3-vl）、语音转文本（qwen3-asr）、文生图（qwen-image），用于 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-workspace-rules
plugins.description: Load Cursor, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot workspace instructions into DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 将 Cursor、Gemini CLI 和 GitHub Copilot 工作区说明加载到 DeepSeek Harness 中。

plugins.name: dsh-safe-web-fetch
plugins.description: SSRF-resistant public-only HTTP(S) WebFetchProvider plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 防 SSRF 的仅公网 HTTP(S) WebFetchProvider 插件，适用于 DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-vision
plugins.description: Vision Bridge for DeepSeek Harness: 识图路由插件，图片交给视觉模型描述后回填给纯文本 DeepSeek
plugins.zh: Vision Bridge for DeepSeek Harness: 识图路由插件，图片交给视觉模型描述后回填给纯文本 DeepSeek

plugins.name: dsh-tool-notify
plugins.description: DSH plugin: model-facing notify tool for DeepSeek Harness — send notifications to ntfy or generic webhooks when an agent task finishes.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：面向模型的 DeepSeek Harness 通知工具——在 Agent 任务完成时发送通知至 ntfy 或通用 Webhook

plugins.name: @qing3a/dsh-tray
plugins.description: Windows 系统托盘插件：托盘图标 + 菜单（打开界面/状态/退出）+ 气泡通知，基于 trayicon（exe 宿主，无 native 编译）
plugins.zh: Windows 系统托盘插件：托盘图标 + 菜单（打开界面/状态/退出）+ 气泡通知，基于 trayicon（exe 宿主，无 native 编译）
